Who We Are – South 40 Snacks

 

 

A letter from our founder

#### Our Story 

 

 

## WHEN DID SNACKS BECOME SO COMPLICATED? 

I’ve been in the snack food world for 20 years. Along with my previous co-founder partner and best friend, we created Sahale Snacks and grew it into a household brand. Our claim to fame was reinventing commoditized trail mix with complexity – essentially amazing combinations of ingredients and flavors.

Flash forward, and here I am again with different insights and perspectives. The calling today is for simplicity and snacks that taste closer to their pure and earthly essence. Nothing over-engineered. No fuss, no fillers.

I believe that living authentically and taking time to enjoy life’s simple pleasures is the best way to live–and to snack. What started as a sunflower seed company has blossomed into a genuine passion for taste, quality and community. So sit back, relax, and snack. We’re just getting started.

–Josh Schroeter

Senior Accountant at Caldera + Lab | Apply now! – Vaia – Talents

# Senior Accountant 

 Full-Time On-site 

About Caldera + Lab: Caldera + Lab is a premium skincare brand for men and one of the fastest-growing DTC startups in the US. Backed by Series A funding and recognized on BeautyMatter's 2025 Future50 list, we're entering an exciting new chapter as we redefine men's skincare with innovative products and a growth-driven, entrepreneurial team culture.

Candidates should take the time to read all the elements of this job advert carefully Please make your application promptly.

About the Role:

We're looking for a dual-threat Senior Accountant: a strong technical accountant with hands-on, in-house operating experience who can own the close, inventory accounting, and compliance end to end, and who is equally comfortable using AI tools (Claude) to automate and accelerate the work. You'll own day-to-day accounting operations and financial reporting, keep our internal controls tight, and help drive the compounding efficiency gains that let Finance support the broader business — not just run a close.

What You'll Work On: Close & Financial ReportingOwn the monthly close end to end — journal entries, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis — delivering accurate GAAP financials on time.

Maintain general ledger integrity; support cash flow reporting, monthly financial reviews, and annual audit and tax requests.

Accounting Operations & ComplianceRun AP and AR, including vendor invoices, and employee reimbursements; reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts.

Support multi-state sales tax and payroll tax compliance; maintain audit-ready documentation and internal controls; oversee third-party accounting resources.

Inventory AccountingOwn inventory reconciliations, valuation, COGS, and related adjustments across 3PLs and sales channels (Shopify, Amazon, retail) without relying on outside inventory support.

Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to resolve discrepancies and keep inventory accounting accurate.

Systems, AI & Process ImprovementUse Claude and other AI tools to automate recurring workflows, reporting, and analysis — and keep finding the next efficiency gain.

Support integrations across QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Amazon, Ramp, and other platforms; document procedures and strengthen controls as we scale.

Collaborate with other departments on cross-functional issues, ad hoc analysis, and budgeting and forecasting support.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's in Accounting, Finance, or related field; 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, the majority in-house at an operating company.

Hands-on experience booking Shopify and Amazon activity into the GL, including payouts, fees, returns, and reserves (strongly preferred).In-house experience at a CPG or eCommerce brand preferred, ideally one with a larger or more complex SKU catalog than ours.

Deep command of GAAP and the month-end close; hands-on inventory and COGS accounting experience preferred.

Fluency with AI tools (e.g., Claude) applied to accounting and finance work, and a drive to automate and improve.

Advanced Excel and Google Sheets; QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

Multi-state sales tax compliance experience preferred.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with clear written and verbal communication.

Ownership mindset; thrives managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. xhyhwjd What Success Looks Like: An accurate, on-time close with minimal corrections; clean P&L and balance sheet reconciliations, timely tax and compliance filings; and measurable, continuous gains in efficiency and automation that free the team to take on more across the business.

About Us – Caldera + Lab

# EFFICACY. DISCIPLINE. RESULTS.

## We create high-performance skincare designed for men, backed by science and built for impact.

 

## Born from the Legacy of a Caldera

At Caldera + Lab, we draw inspiration from the incredible resilience of nature and the meticulous precision of science. This is how we have approached product development since 2019. Our routines are as effective as they are easy to use. From nature, powered by biotech, with proven clinical efficacy.

Brand Mission

## Men’s Skincare Innovation Was An Oxymoron. We Changed That.

Men’s self-care has long been stagnant when it comes to innovation. We believe skincare should be as forward thinking as the men who use it. Caldera + Lab sets a new standard in the skincare experience for men. We combine uncompromising craftsmanship, state of the art manufacturing, exceptional ingredients with an audited supply chain, and use recyclable and sustainable packaging.

 

 

Brand Vision

## Move Daily. Eat Right. Apply Skincare.

At the heart of what we do is this core belief: skin and hair care are tools that optimize your well-being and health span. High-performance self-care and consistency of a daily regimen can unlock longevity and a new level of personal progress and confidence. Our science serves to support men on this journey.

## Responsible and Transparent From the Start.

Caldera + Lab is committed to Transparency, Sustainability, Excellence. But your trust has to be earned, which is why we have gone the extra mile to become certified by the leading regulatory bodies that assess non-toxicity, social impact, and environmental impact. We proudly embrace accountability.

## Integrity isn’t an accident. It’s a choice.

 

### Made Safe

Caldera + Lab gladly opened our doors for Made Safe’s inspectors to audit our entire production chain. As America’s first non-toxic certification association, they’ve confirmed that we only use non-toxic ingredients in our products, production process, and supply chain. Made Safe is the first association to go beyond organic regulations and the EPA’s registered 85,000 chemicals, to classify toxins that build up over time in our bodies, environment, and oceans.

 

### Leaping Bunny

Leaping Bunny Certification is the international Gold Standard for cosmetics, personal care, animal care, and household products. Their certification confirms that Caldera + Lab has implemented a supplier monitoring system to ensure that our products as well as ingredients are not tested on animals.

 

### rePurpose Global

Certified plastic neutral in partnership with rePurpose Global. With every product we sell, we are financing vetted impact projects that will recover and remove as much plastic waste from the environment as we use in our packaging and operations. In addition to reducing plastic use in our supply chain wherever possible, our partnership with rePurpose Global allows us to create immediate impact on plastic pollution, while supporting ethical wages for often marginalized waste workers.

Our products feature clinically proven ingredients using next-generation bio-delivery technologies to enhance cellular-level absorption and drive measurable health benefits. Founded with the vision to deliver unparalleled cellular absorption, we focus on transparency, effectiveness, and empowering individuals to understand and optimize their supplementation. Operating across Shopify DTC, Amazon, and national retail, Rho serves hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling rapidly while maintaining our strict standards. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Controller to own Rho's accounting operations. Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will run the close, safeguard the integrity of our financial statements, lead tax and audit readiness, and build the processes, controls, and systems a fast-growing, multi-channel CPG business needs. This is a working leader role: you will set direction for the accounting function and coach a small team, while staying close enough to the detail to review reconciliations, post entries, and solve problems yourself. You will also be a trusted business partner to Operations, Sales, and Leadership. Key Responsibilities Close & Financial Reporting

- Maintain general ledger integrity through regular balance sheet reviews and account analyses.
- Develop and maintain accounting policies and technical accounting guidance. 

Revenue, Inventory & Cost Accounting 

- Reconcile revenue and COGS across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, wholesale distributors, and retail in accordance with ASC 606.
- Own inventory and cost accounting, including inventory balances, adjustments, and COGS reconciliations.
- Ensure accurate accounting for customer deductions, rebates, promotional allowances, and chargebacks. 

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Payroll 

- Oversee AP and AR, including wholesale invoicing, collections, vendor onboarding, W-9/W-8 collection, and annual 1099 reporting.
- Review weekly AR aging and work with customers to resolve payment disputes, deductions, and chargebacks.
- Oversee semi-monthly payroll in Rippling and review payroll reports for accuracy and compliance. 

Tax Compliance 

- Own multi-state sales tax compliance: review filings prepared through Numeral, upload monthly.
- Partner with external advisors on federal, state, and local income tax compliance and planning.
- Prepare tax schedules and documentation, and track and resolve tax notices. 

Audit & Internal Controls 

- Serve as the primary accounting contact for external auditors and lead audit preparation, schedules, and requests.
- Design, document, and maintain internal controls that keep pace with the company's growth.
- Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and regulatory requirements. 

Systems & Process Improvement 

- Lead implementation of an ERP as we scale beyond QuickBooks Online, then drive its ongoing optimization.
- Identify and deliver automation and process improvements that increase speed, accuracy, and scalability.

 JOB OVERVIEW 

 Inventory Controller Location: Remote — Philippines | Type: Full-time, remote (engaged as an independent contractor) | Level: Individual Contributor | Reports to: Director, Supply Chain Schedule: Core overlap with US business hours required. About Rhino USA Rhino USA is a family-founded brand that designs and sells premium tie-down straps, recovery gear, and outdoor and automotive accessories. We sell across our own storefronts and major marketplaces, ship from multiple domestic and international warehouses, and run our operations on the Fulfil ERP. As we scale across channels and regions, keeping a single, trustworthy view of inventory is mission-critical — and that is exactly what this role owns. The Role We are hiring a detail-obsessed Inventory Controller to be the person who makes our inventory numbers true. You will reconcile stock, movements, and settlement data across every channel and warehouse we operate — Fulfil ERP, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and other marketplaces, our 3PL/WMS feeds, and our international warehouses — and turn a tangle of conflicting reports into one clean, defensible source of truth. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys hunting down a 12-unit discrepancy until they know exactly where it came from. You will not manage a team; you will own the accuracy of the data itself. If you find satisfaction in a reconciliation that ties out to zero, you will fit in well here. What You'll Do Multi-channel reconciliation (the core of the job) Reconcile on-hand, inbound, reserved, and in-transit inventory between Fulfil ERP (our system of record) and every sales channel and warehouse, identifying and resolving every variance. Own channel-level reconciliation across Amazon (Seller & Vendor Central / FBA & FBM), Walmart, TikTok Shop, and our other marketplaces and storefronts — matching stock ledgers, inbound/receiving records, reserved and unfulfillable quantities, and settlement/financial reports back to Fulfil. Reconcile 3PL and warehouse (WMS) feeds — receipts, putaways, picks, adjustments, and cycle counts — against ERP records for both domestic and international warehouses, accounting for multi-currency, multi-location, and customs/in-transit nuances. Investigate root causes of discrepancies (mis-scans, timing/cutoff differences, unmapped SKUs, returns not processed, FX and unit-of-measure mismatches, sync failures) and drive them to resolution rather than just flagging them. Reconcile Amazon and marketplace reimbursements, lost/damaged inventory, and settlement data, and open/track cases to recover what we're owed. Data accuracy & controls Maintain accurate SKU mappings, unit-of-measure conversions, and channel listings so data flows cleanly between systems. Design and run a recurring cycle-count and audit cadence with warehouse partners, and lead investigation of count-to-system variances. Post and document inventory adjustments in Fulfil with clear, auditable notes and supporting evidence. Monitor system syncs and integrations for failures or drift; escalate and follow up until data is aligned again. Reporting & continuous improvement Produce clear, recurring reconciliation reports and inventory-accuracy dashboards for Supply Chain and Finance, with variances quantified and explained. Build and maintain reconciliation workbooks / trackers (advanced spreadsheets, and reporting inside Fulfil) that others can trust and follow. Document repeatable SOPs for every reconciliation process you own, and continuously tighten them to reduce recurring errors. Surface trends and systemic problems (channels or warehouses that drift most, common error types) and recommend process or system fixes. Rhino USA Dealer Program

 

## THE RHINO DEALER PROGRAM IS TRANSITIONING TO NATIONAL DISTRIBUTORS 

### Existing dealers will still have access to their account and can place orders up until April 30th, 2026.

## Dealer Program Transition FAQ 

 What is changing? 

Rhino USA is transitioning away from the direct dealer program and moving to a national distributor model. 

We are streamlining our operations to better support long-term growth and strengthen our national distribution network. This move allows us to improve inventory positioning, fulfillment speed, and provide broader access through best-in-class distribution partners.

Our business is to make bad ass products….not distribution so we want to work with the experts there to ensure you get RhinoUSA products in the best manner possible!

 What is the last day dealers can place direct orders? 

The final day for existing dealer orders is April 30, 2026.

After this date:

- Shopify wholesale access will be turned off
- Dealers will be directed to purchase through distributors

 Which distributors can potential and new dealers order from? 

We have existing relationships with:

- Meyer Distributing
- Turn 14
- Turn 5
- JB Tools
- Quadratec
- Sunrise Distributors

If you have a national distributor that you work with that you think would be great to sell Rhino products please reach out to: dealers@rhinousainc.com.

 How to get in touch with these new distributors? 

Meyer

- https://www.meyerdistributing.com/Customers/ApplicationTerms.aspx
- Download the new customer application and fill it out. 
- Then email it to CustApps@MeyerDistributing.com. That would get them assigned an account manager.
- Our CURRENT DEALERS can also email Leads.Mailbox@meyerdistributing.com and that will get them assigned an account manager that will call them back and can provide any info they need.

Turn 14

- https://turn14.formstack.com/forms/dealer_application
- Fill out the dealer application. They will then be assigned an account manager.

 Will pricing change? 

Dealers will receive competitive wholesale pricing through our distribution partners.

 What happens to existing orders placed before April 30? 

 All orders placed before April 30 will be fulfilled as normal under current terms.

There will be no disruption to orders already confirmed.

 What happens after April 30 if a dealer tries to log in? 

Wholesale access will be disabled.

The Dealer page on both our Rhino website and Shopify platform will be updated to reflect these changes and will direct dealers to dealers@rhinousainc.com for any questions or support.

 Will Rhino still support warranty or product issues? 

Yes. Rhino USA will continue handling:

- Product warranties
- Product support
- Customer service issues

The change only impacts how dealers purchase inventory.

# Third-Party Marketplace Sales Prohibition Policy

This Third-Party Marketplace Sales Prohibition Policy (the “Policy”) governs the sale, distribution, and resale of all products offered by Rho Nutrition (the “Products”).

### 1. Absolute Prohibition on Marketplace Sales

The sale, listing, offering for sale, distribution, or advertising of Rho Nutrition Products on any third-party online marketplace is strictly prohibited.

This includes, without limitation:

- Amazon
- Walmart
- eBay
- Any other online marketplace, auction platform, or third-party resale channel

This prohibition applies worldwide and without exception.

### 2. Binding Agreement and Acceptance

This Policy is incorporated by reference into all agreements between Rho Nutrition and any purchaser, reseller, distributor, retailer, affiliate, or partner (each, a “Partner”).

By purchasing, reselling, distributing, or otherwise dealing in Rho Nutrition Products, each Partner:

- Acknowledges receipt of this Policy
- Agrees to be legally bound by its terms
- Agrees that compliance with this Policy is a material condition of any commercial relationship with Rho Nutrition

Failure to comply constitutes a material breach of contract.

### 3. Application Regardless of Source

This prohibition applies regardless of how Products are obtained, including:

- Direct purchase from Rho Nutrition
- Purchase through authorized distributors, including KeHE or similar partners
- Purchase from retail stores
- Any secondary or downstream transaction

No party may circumvent this Policy by sourcing Products through indirect channels.

### 4. No Authorization; Reservation of Rights

Rho Nutrition does not authorize any third-party marketplace sales under any circumstances.

No oral statement, course of dealing, or prior conduct shall create any exception. Any purported authorization not expressly granted in a written agreement signed by Rho Nutrition is void. Rho Nutrition expressly reserves all rights to control distribution and sales channels.

### 5. Quality Control and Material Differences

Rho Nutrition maintains strict quality control standards that are essential to product integrity, safety, and consumer trust.

Products sold outside authorized channels, including third-party marketplaces:

- Are not subject to Rho Nutrition’s quality control, storage, or handling standards
- May be expired, improperly stored, or altered
- Are not eligible for any guarantees, support, or customer protections offered by Rho Nutrition

As a result, such Products are materially different from those sold through authorized channels. Unauthorized resale may mislead consumers and damage Rho Nutrition’s brand and reputation.

### 6. Intellectual Property and Unfair Competition

Any unauthorized marketplace listing or sale may constitute trademark infringement, false designation of origin, unfair competition, and unauthorized use of proprietary content, including product images, descriptions, and branding.

Rho Nutrition actively enforces its intellectual property rights and will pursue all available remedies.

### 7. Enforcement and Remedies

Rho Nutrition reserves the right to take immediate enforcement action for any violation, including termination of any agreement or business relationship, suspension or revocation of purchasing privileges, cancellation of pending or future orders, refusal to fulfill future orders, and pursuit of legal action.

Rho Nutrition may seek recovery of damages, including lost profits and reputational harm, as well as injunctive relief and recovery of attorneys’ fees and costs where permitted by law. All rights and remedies are cumulative and non-exclusive.

# Where to Buy Rho Supplements 

You’ve done the research. You understand why delivery format matters. Now you just want to make sure you’re getting the real thing.

That’s where things can get unnecessarily complicated.

Search for Rho supplements and you’ll find multiple storefronts, listings, and resellers claiming to carry the same products. Some are legitimate. Some are not. And when you’re dealing with liposomal formulations, how a product is stored and handled isn’t a small detail—it directly impacts quality.

This guide breaks down where to buy Rho supplements, where to find them in-store, and how to avoid the common pitfalls that come with third-party sellers.

## The Best Place to Buy Rho Supplements

If you want the most straightforward option, buy directly from the official Rho website.

That removes the guesswork entirely.

When you purchase through Rho’s official store, you’re getting products that come straight from the source—without sitting in unknown warehouses or passing through multiple resellers.

There are also practical advantages:

- Full product selection Every Rho supplement, bundle, and new release is available in one place.
- Fresh inventory Products are shipped directly, reducing the risk of extended storage time.
- Subscription options If you’re using supplements consistently, auto-ship can simplify the process and often reduce cost over time.
- Direct customer support Questions are handled by the team behind the products—not a third-party seller.
- Satisfaction policies Official guarantees and return options typically apply only to direct purchases.

If your goal is consistency—same product, same quality, every time—buying direct is the cleanest solution.

## Where to Buy Rho Supplements In-Store

If you prefer to shop in person, Rho supplements are also available through select retail partners.

You can find Rho products at stores like:

- Sprouts Farmers Market
- GNC
- Lassens Natural Foods & Vitamins
- Erewhon Market
- The Vitamin Shoppe
- Kimberton Whole Foods

Availability can vary by location, so it’s worth checking ahead of time.

For the most accurate and up-to-date list of retailers near you, use the official store locator: https://rhonutrition.com/pages/store-locator

Buying in-store gives you the benefit of immediate access—no shipping wait—and allows you to see products firsthand. Just keep in mind that selection may be more limited compared to the full online catalog.

## Can You Buy Rho on Amazon or Other Retailers?

This is where things get less clear—and where most issues tend to happen.

You may come across Rho products on marketplaces like Amazon or other third-party platforms. The key question isn’t whether they exist there—it’s who is actually selling them and how they’ve been handled.

With liposomal supplements, that matters more than most people think.

These formulations are more sensitive than standard capsules or tablets. Factors like temperature, light exposure, and storage time can affect stability. Once products move outside controlled distribution, those variables become harder to track.

Potential risks with unauthorized or unclear sellers include:

- Unknown storage conditions
- Extended time sitting in warehouses
- No guarantee of authenticity
- Limited or no access to brand-backed support or return policies

This doesn’t mean every third-party listing is problematic. But it does mean you’re relying on information you can’t fully verify.

If consistency and product integrity matter to you, buying direct—or through trusted retail partners—is the safer move.

## How to Spot Fake or Expired Supplements

Not every issue is obvious at first glance. Packaging can look legitimate, and listings can appear polished. But there are a few ways to reduce your risk.

- Clean, consistent labeling
- Proper seals and closures
- No visible damage or tampering

# Privacy policy

This Privacy Policy describes how uprootlint.com (the “Site” or “we”) collects, uses, and discloses your Personal Information when you visit or make a purchase from the Site.

When you visit the Site, we collect certain information about your device, your interaction with the Site, and information necessary to process your purchases. We may also collect additional information if you contact us for customer support. In this Privacy Policy, we refer to any information that can uniquely identify an individual (including the information below) as “Personal Information”. See the list below for more information about what Personal Information we collect and why.

Device information

- Examples of Personal Information collected: version of web browser, IP address, time zone, cookie information, what sites or products you view, search terms, and how you interact with the Site.

- Source of collection: Collected automatically when you access our Site using cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, or pixels/

# Controller

## TLDR

Build scalable accounting processes across NetSuite, inventory, and multichannel revenue operations while supporting retail expansion.

About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, scalp-first textured haircare company serving customers across direct-to-consumer, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and major retail channels. We are a lean, entrepreneurial organization that moves quickly, operates with high ownership, and expects team members to turn priorities into action without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

Role Overview

The Controller will own the accounting function end-to-end and serve as the backbone of financial integrity, reporting, and operational discipline. This role will partner closely with the Head of Finance to build scalable processes and support retail expansion.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both execution and system-building.

1. Financial Close and Reporting

- Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
- Establish a path to preliminary financial reporting within five business days and a complete, supportable close within ten business days.
- Prepare accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements.
- Own balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals, reserves, account substantiation, and financial-statement support.
- Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready documentation.
- Develop and maintain the accounting calendar, close checklist, and departmental deadlines.
- Coordinate external audit and tax requirements.
- Identify accounting issues proactively and present clear recommendations to the Head of Finance.

2. Inventory, COGS, and Gross-Margin Integrity

- Own inventory accounting across manufacturers, 3PLs, marketplaces, retail channels, and DTC operations.
- Reconcile inventory monthly among the general ledger, NetSuite, 3PL records, retailer activity, and internal inventory schedules.
- Establish reliable standard costs, landed costs, manufacturing variances, and SKU-level COGS.
- Own accounting for inventory in transit, shrinkage, obsolescence, damaged inventory, reserves, and write-offs.
- Partner with Supply Chain on purchase-order receipts, freight accruals, vendor reconciliations, and cycle-count controls.
- Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies promptly.
- Improve gross-margin visibility by SKU, product category, channel, and customer.
- Ensure inventory accounting policies and valuation methodologies are consistently documented and applied.

3. Revenue and Channel Accounting

- Own revenue accounting and settlement reconciliation across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, wholesale, and other marketplace and retail channels.
- Ensure appropriate revenue recognition, cutoff, and channel-level reporting.
- Reconcile platform settlements, transaction fees, refunds, returns, reserves, receivables, and cash receipts.
- Own accounting for retailer deductions, chargebacks, promotions, markdowns, allowances, and trade spend.
- Ensure accurate gross-to-net and contra-revenue treatment.
- Build controls to identify missing payments, invalid deductions, unreimbursed claims, and settlement discrepancies.
- Partner with Commercialization, E-Commerce, Customer Experience, and Supply Chain to resolve channel and retailer discrepancies.
- Maintain reliable supporting schedules for retail receivables, marketplace settlements, returns, and deductions.

4. Cash, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Working Capital

- Oversee the accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including management and development of the existing AP/AR Specialist.
- Maintain accurate daily and weekly cash reporting.
- Support short- and long-term cash-flow forecasting.

# Senior Cost Accountant at Lilyandfox

- **Company:** Lilyandfox
- **Location:** Unit C, 220 W Campus Drive, Arglinton Heights, 60004
- **Department:** Finance
- **Published:** 2026-09-25

Lily and Fox is a private company. Lily & Fox is a company that offers a wide range of nail wraps and nail stickers. They have over 1000 colors and patterns on their products, providing no chips or cracks. They offer worldwide delivery and have an online ordering platform. It has 8 employees.

# Description

Lily & Fox is a direct-to-consumer nail wrap brand with 35 employees across the US, Australia, and Germany. We design, sell, and fulfill 10,000+ designs, ship worldwide, and are in the middle of bringing manufacturing in-house at our US facility - a transition that will make us one of the few vertically integrated players in our category. Our mission is to make beauty products radically more affordable and easier to use, starting with nails.

Finance today is lean; you'll be building alongside us, not inheriting a mature department.

*What you’ll do:*

You'll own the core accounting engine: monthly close, reconciliations, and accurate financials across a multi-entity, multi-currency business. As manufacturing spins up, the role grows into inventory and cost accounting - landed cost, WIP, standard costing, and variance analysis for a high-SKU (~1,500 active SKUs), low-price-point ($2.99) product line where unit economics precision actually matters.

This is a hands-on role reporting to the CEO. You will not have a team on day one. You will work closely with internal operational teams, and external accounting and tax firms. This is an individual-contributor role with the opportunity to help build and improve the company’s accounting infrastructure.

*Responsibilities:*

- Own the monthly close end-to-end: journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations (bank, merchant processors, marketplace payouts), and financial statement preparation

- Reconcile Shopify, PayPal, and payment processor settlements against bank deposits and revenue records

- Manage multi-entity bookkeeping across US, Australian, and German operations, including intercompany transactions and FX

- Build and maintain inventory accounting as we transition to in-house manufacturing: raw materials, WIP, finished goods, landed cost, and cost of goods sold

- Support sales tax (US), GST (AU), and VAT (DE/EU) compliance in coordination with external advisors

- Prepare schedules and documentation for external accountants at tax time; be the internal point of contact

- Identify and fix process gaps — you should leave every workflow more automated and better documented than you found it

- Partner with operations on physical inventory counts, shrink analysis, and cycle counting as manufacturing scales

*What we're looking for:*

- 4+ years of progressive accounting experience with full ownership of a monthly close

- Inventory or cost accounting experience — manufacturing, CPG, e-commerce, or distribution strongly preferred

- Experience with e-commerce revenue recognition (Shopify or similar platform settlements, refunds, chargebacks, gift cards) is a significant plus

- Multi-entity or multi-currency exposure is a plus

- CPA or CPA-track preferred but not required if experience is strong

- Comfort with spreadsheets at an advanced level; comfort with (or curiosity about) SQL is a plus — our data lives in PostgreSQL and you'll get more leverage if you can query it

- Bias toward documentation and systems. We are building this function, not maintaining it

What this role is not:

- It is not remote or hybrid - the interesting parts of this job (manufacturing costing, inventory) happen at the facility

- It is not a big-company role with narrow scope - you'll touch everything, and ambiguity is part of the deal

Process:

- Application → skills assessment → structured interview (behavioral + technical case) → final interview with the CEO → offer.

We respond to every applicant

# Senior Cost Accountant at Lilyandfox

- **Company:** Lilyandfox
- **Location:** Unit C, 220 W Campus Drive, Arglinton Heights, 60004
- **Department:** Finance
- **Published:** 2026-10-30

Lily and Fox is a private company. Lily & Fox is a company that offers a wide range of nail wraps and nail stickers. They have over 1000 colors and patterns on their products, providing no chips or cracks. They offer worldwide delivery and have an online ordering platform. It has 8 employees.

# Description

Lily & Fox is a direct-to-consumer nail wrap brand with 35 employees across the US, Australia, and Germany. We design, sell, and fulfill 10,000+ designs, ship worldwide, and are in the middle of bringing manufacturing in-house at our US facility - a transition that will make us one of the few vertically integrated players in our category. Our mission is to make beauty products radically more affordable and easier to use, starting with nails.

Finance today is lean; you'll be building alongside us, not inheriting a mature department.

*What you’ll do:*

You'll own the core accounting engine: monthly close, reconciliations, and accurate financials across a multi-entity, multi-currency business. As manufacturing spins up, the role grows into inventory and cost accounting - landed cost, WIP, standard costing, and variance analysis for a high-SKU (~1,500 active SKUs), low-price-point ($2.99) product line where unit economics precision actually matters.

This is a hands-on role reporting to the CEO. You will not have a team on day one. You will work closely with internal operational teams, and external accounting and tax firms. This is an individual-contributor role with the opportunity to help build and improve the company’s accounting infrastructure.

*Responsibilities:*

- Own the monthly close end-to-end: journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations (bank, merchant processors, marketplace payouts), and financial statement preparation

- Reconcile Shopify, PayPal, and payment processor settlements against bank deposits and revenue records

- Manage multi-entity bookkeeping across US, Australian, and German operations, including intercompany transactions and FX

- Build and maintain inventory accounting as we transition to in-house manufacturing: raw materials, WIP, finished goods, landed cost, and cost of goods sold

- Support sales tax (US), GST (AU), and VAT (DE/EU) compliance in coordination with external advisors

- Prepare schedules and documentation for external accountants at tax time; be the internal point of contact

- Identify and fix process gaps — you should leave every workflow more automated and better documented than you found it

- Partner with operations on physical inventory counts, shrink analysis, and cycle counting as manufacturing scales

*What we're looking for:*

- 4+ years of progressive accounting experience with full ownership of a monthly close

- Inventory or cost accounting experience — manufacturing, CPG, e-commerce, or distribution strongly preferred

- Experience with e-commerce revenue recognition (Shopify or similar platform settlements, refunds, chargebacks, gift cards) is a significant plus

- Multi-entity or multi-currency exposure is a plus

- CPA or CPA-track preferred but not required if experience is strong

- Comfort with spreadsheets at an advanced level; comfort with (or curiosity about) SQL is a plus — our data lives in PostgreSQL and you'll get more leverage if you can query it

- Bias toward documentation and systems. We are building this function, not maintaining it

*What Lily & Fox Offers:*

- Attractive salary + equity

- Company paid insurance (medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance)

- 5 weeks PTO per year (vacation, sick, holidays)

- 401k

- Coaching and training

- Huge opportunities to learn new skills and grow with the company!

- Being a part of a fast-growing international business!

# About UltrAspire

 

Welcome to the UltrAspire family.

Our gear is inspired by athletes, designed for performance, and revised to perfection.

 How did a young man change hydration and running forever? 

 UltrAspire CEO Bryce Thatcher describes the early days of running, hydration, and his career. 

 "In all my years of designing, it has always been my dream to build packs for others that I would choose for myself without worrying about price, volume, or mass production. It is not my goal to be all things to all people—just to provide extraordinary choices for extraordinary people. People, who know when something feels right and good. 

 The most intuitive ideas for such products emerge from the interface of both engaging in the activity, and the active involvement and interaction of other dedicated athletes, who are inspired by what they do and what they need to do it. Finally, testing by all, feedback, more feedback and an on-going evolution of perfection. 

 It is evident that every athlete has different needs and goals, but all have some basic, very human, requirements. Being involved in running events brings one into a new family with a shared experience; where, each person is important; where, excruciating moments are shouldered by all and where the smallest of triumphs uplifts the whole!

About Us – Vaca Chips

# Our Story 

## From Fast Food to Whole Foods 

Seven years ago, I was the guy who didn’t care what he ate. Fast food, drive-thru dinners, chips loaded with junk - I lived off it. But eventually, it caught up with me. I started feeling run down, and I knew something had to change.

So I cleaned up my diet, got serious about my health, and never looked back. Steak, fruit, and whole foods became my foundation. And with that shift, I began paying attention to every ingredient I put into my body.

## The Chip Problem 

I’ve always loved chips and salsa, but as I started eating better, I realized nearly every chip on the shelf was fried in seed oils. Even the so-called “healthy” ones tasted bland, processed, and left me unsatisfied. I kept buying them, but they never truly hit.

By the end of 2024, I decided to stop settling. I wanted a chip that actually lived up to the food I cared about eating - bold, flavorful, and made with real ingredients. That’s when Vaca Chips was born.

## Crafting Vaca Chips 

I spent months testing tortilla styles, experimenting with cooking methods, and perfecting the exact beef tallow that gave the chip a rich, creamy finish. It became an obsession - creating a chip that tasted like it came straight out of a legit taquería, but without the junk.

Along the way, I brought in my friend Josh as a full-time partner. We both shared the same passion for bold food and clean ingredients from the start. Together, we put in late nights, countless test batches, and a relentless focus on flavor and quality.

Vaca Chips is the result of it all - a chip that’s bold, clean, and worthy of your table. Thanks for being part of the journey.

— Brian Gibb, Founder & CEO

# Jackson Jones

Founder & CEO at Farm to Pet | Scale & Operations Executive | Former VP of Supply Chain (Duracell & Marmon Group) | Single-Ingredient Pet Nutrition

## About

I’m the founder and CEO of Farm to Pet, but I’ve always been a “hands-on” operator. My career is rooted in the belief that the best outcomes—whether in global supply chains or pet nutrition—come from understanding the details, embracing systematic improvement, and good old fashioned hard work. My journey here wasn't a straight line. Growing up working on my grandparents’ farm in rural Illinois, I learned early on that ingenuity, sustainability, and hard work are the foundations of any good business. That upbringing instilled in me a lifelong love for nature and a drive to solve problems, which eventually led me to a career in operations. Over the last two decades, I’ve had the privilege of scaling operations for industry leaders, progressing from a tech analyst at Caterpillar to a global supply chain VP at Berkshire Hathaway companies like Duracell and the Marmon Group. Those years were an incredible masterclass in Lean principles, capital efficiency, and navigating complex logistical landscapes. I saw firsthand how 80/20 principles, innovation and operational rigor could transform a business. Eventually, the "entrepreneurial voice" became too loud to ignore. I founded Farm to Pet to bridge the gap between institutional supply chain expertise and the need for simple, transparent, and healthy pet nutrition. We started experimenting with our signature dog treats in 2020 from the basement of our Chicago home, with my wife, our children, and our rescue dog, Rooney (our official treat taster), by my side. Today, Farm to Pet has grown into a community of over 100,000 supportive, pet-loving customers. We operate our manufacturing and distribution facility, allowing us to maintain complete control over our quality and supply chain. By keeping production local and focusing on human-grade, single-ingredient treats, we’ve proven that you can be ethical, sustainable, and highly efficient at the same time. I’m incredibly proud of the impact we’ve had on thousands of dogs and cats so far, but we’re just getting started. Whether it’s through our partnerships, our commitment to clean proteins, or our next stage of growth, I am dedicated to bringing real transparency to the pet industry. I love connecting with fellow pet parents, entrepreneurs, technologists and supply chain leaders. Feel free to reach out—I’d love to share more about our mission to help pets live happier, healthier lives.

## About

I’ve spent most of my career convincing people that a sleeping bag with arms and legs is actually a very good idea. And somehow, it worked. I’m the CEO of Selk’bag, the Original Wearable Sleeping Bag. The brand was born in Chile and has grown from an unusual outdoor product into something much bigger, sold internationally and through retailers like REI. My journey with Selk’bag brought me from Chile to the U.S., where I learned pretty quickly that building a brand in a new market is a completely different game. Over the years, I’ve worked across almost every part of the business: ecommerce, retail, product development, marketing, operations, partnerships and plenty of things that definitely weren’t in the original job description. What still interests me most is building. Building products people haven’t seen before. Building a brand people remember. Figuring out why something works in one market and completely fails in another. And lately, challenging some of our own assumptions about what Selk’bag can become. We started in outdoor. We’re building toward lifestyle. I’m using LinkedIn to share more of that journey: the good decisions, the bad ones, old prototypes, retail stories, marketing experiments, things we’re testing now and some of what I wish I’d known earlier. If you’re building an interesting brand, working in retail, ecommerce or consumer products, or just appreciate businesses that are a little difficult to categorize, feel free to connect.

Selk’bag is sold in 10+ countries and available through major retailers including REI and others. The brand has been featured by The New York Times, TODAY, Good Morning America and more. The SelkBag Story: Comfort, Creativity and Outdoor Fun

# Our Story 

## Bringing fun and comfort to the outdoors 

### Originated in Chile, the Selk’bag is a wearable sleeping bag that was designed to encourage adventure by creating freedom of movement, in total warmth and comfort, no matter the conditions. 

### Over 10 years ago, we were camping with our friends in the Chilean Andes. The weather was typically cool and we just brought basic mummy sleeping bags. Once we were in our sleeping bags, we felt restricted, we couldn't move our arms or legs and wondered why sleeping bags are shaped like this. From that simple moment came a big idea: Let's make a human shaped sleeping bag! More than 10 years later our idea has become a company that sells wearable sleeping bags and FUNctional gear, to outdoor enthusiasts all over the world. Our mission is to bring more comfort and fun to the outdoors, while fostering respect for the outdoors, our environment, and each other. We're a small team of hikers, surfers, climbers, outdoor enthusiasts with an unwavering passion for the outdoors. We get so much love and appreciation from Selk'ers every day around the globe. Thank you! Stay cozy, stay comfortable

# Careers

Customer Service Representative 

We’re looking for an enthusiastic & energetic FULL TIME Customer Service Representative in our Carlsbad, CA office. The ideal candidate takes pride in helping people, solving problems, and ensuring our customers feel heard and appreciated. 

The primary responsibilities of this position will be to interact with e-commerce customers on a daily basis via phone, email, and chat. On a daily basis you’ll interact with existing and future customers to fulfil their Zoot orders and where necessary, help them to resolve complaints, process returns and exchanges.

We’re looking for a dynamic, multi-faceted person who has aspirations to grow professionally, as this position will provide a path for upward mobility as our business evolves.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Customer Service 

· Respond promptly to direct customer inquiries via telephone and email

· Interact directly with customers via live web chat

· Resolve customer complaints / issues

· Continually maintain working knowledge of all company products, services and promotions

· Review legitimacy of suspicious orders

2. Order Fulfillment & Inventory Control 

· Review and assess customer returns for quality control on a daily basis 

· Help fulfill and ship orders, as needed

· Greet and assist customers at our HQ Showroom and guide at once purchases.

3. Data Management & Evaluation

· Analyze customer feedback and identify needs for future products

· Provide feedback on the efficiency of the customer service process

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS 

· 1-2 years previous customer service experience preferred with thorough knowledge of customer service principles and practices

· Apparel experience desired, but not required

· Product knowledge and experience in Triathlon, Run or Cycle sports a plus

· Experience using Shopify desired, but not required.

REQUIRED SKILLS & ABILITIES 

· Solid communication skills, verbal and written

· Able to resolve problems in a timely and amicable manner

· High attention to detail and accuracy

· Well organized

· Initiative, pro-active, and adaptable

· Reliable, dependable, and on time

To apply for this position:

If you are seeking a position in a company, which fosters and supports health and fitness, personal development, growth, change, responsibility and overall success please submit your resume.

NOTE: Local applicants preferred. This position does not offer any compensation for re-location.

Only those applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please accept our utmost appreciation for your interest.

Residency Note: To be eligible to apply for this role, you must be a US citizen or have an appropriate visa to live and work in the US. 

For more information and the full job description please send a resume and cover letter to mike.lyons@zootsports.com

# Privacy policy

PRIVACY POLICY

This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from www.flybyjing.com (the “Site”).

 PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT

When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies that are installed on your device. Additionally, as you browse the Site, we collect information about the individual web pages or products that you view, what websites or search terms referred you to the Site, and information about how you interact with the Site. We refer to this automatically-collected information as “Device Information.” 

We collect Device Information using the following technologies: 

 - “Cookies” are data files that are placed on your device or computer and often include an anonymous unique identifier. For more information about cookies, and how to disable cookies, visit http://www.allaboutcookies.org.

 - “Log files” track actions occurring on the Site, and collect data including your IP address, browser type, Internet service provider, referring/exit pages, and date/time stamps.

 - “Web beacons,” “tags,” and “pixels” are electronic files used to record information about how you browse the Site.

Additionally when you make a purchase or attempt to make a purchase through the Site, we collect certain information from you, including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment information (including credit card numbers, Stripe or other similar companies), email address, and phone number. We refer to this information as “Order Information.”

When we talk about “Personal Information” in this Privacy Policy, we are talking both about Device Information and Order Information.

HOW DO WE USE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?

We use the Order Information that we collect generally to fulfill any orders placed through the Site (including processing your payment information, arranging for shipping, and providing you with invoices and/or order confirmations). Additionally, we use this Order Information to:

Communicate with you;

Screen our orders for potential risk or fraud; and

When in line with the preferences you have shared with us, provide you with information or advertising relating to our products or services.

We use the Device Information that we collect to help us screen for potential risk and fraud (in particular, your IP address), and more generally to improve and optimize our Site (for example, by generating analytics about how our customers browse and interact with the Site, and to assess the success of our marketing and advertising campaigns).

SHARING YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION

We share your Personal Information with third parties to help us use your Personal Information, as described above. For example, we use Shopify to power our online store--you can read more about how Shopify uses your Personal Information here: https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy. We also use Google Analytics to help us understand how our customers use the Site--you can read more about how Google uses your Personal Information here: https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/privacy/. You can also opt-out of Google Analytics here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Finally, we may also share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, to respond to a subpoena, search warrant or other lawful request for information we receive, or to otherwise protect our rights.

BEHAVIOURAL ADVERTISING

As described above, we use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. # FAQ 

## Shipping

We offer shipping within the continental United States. Based on the increased cost of shipping, we are not able to ship to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, or the U.S. Virgin Islands at this time (you can find a retailer near you here).

Standard shipping is free for orders over $75 and there is a $8 flat rate economy fee for orders under $75. At this time, we are not offering international shipping (but we hope to soon!).

All orders are shipped from our third party fulfillment partner within 48 to 72 hours and are shipped via DHL/USPS, FedEx or UPS. Once picked up by the carrier, standard shipping transit time is 3-7 business days depending on your region.

## Gift Wrapping + Custom Notes

We do not offer gift wrapping, however the Triple Threat Gift Box, Shorty Triple Threat and Jing's Favorites come in gift-ready, limited edition luxury packaging. 

You can add a gift note at checkout too! It will print on the packing slip.

## Returns + Refunds

In the rare event that your package is lost or damaged in transit, please contact us at support@flybyjing.com.

If you aren't completely happy with your products, email or call us within 7 days of receipt and we will refund your order.

## Wholesale + Corporate Orders

We are also available at select premium retailers in the US.

If you're a retailer and would like to stock Fly By Jing products, please reach out at wholesale@flybyjing.com.

Please visit our page here for more information on bulk & corporate orders.

## Storage + Shelf Life

Our sauces are shelf stable and can be safely stored at ambient temperatures. Our pantry items and sauces do not need to be refrigerated, however doing so can help to extend their freshness since we do not use preservatives in our products.

## Are the sauces vegan?

All of our sauces, spice mix and pantry items are vegan, non-GMO and include no artificial additives or preservatives.

## Contact Us

Email: support@flybyjing.com

Mailing Address: 1439 N. Highland Ave PMB 1010 Los Angeles, CA 90028

## Press

We'd love to answer any questions! Please send an email to flybyjing@isetta.co

## Event Samples

## About

I make things that help people wake up without burning themselves out. I’m the co-founder and CEO of MUD\WTR. We make functional alternatives for our most shared behaviors: how we rise, rest, nourish, and gather. Prior to starting the business in 2018, I worked as a creative in tech and CPG, designing mobile and web interfaces, branding, marketing collateral, and writing copy. Along the way, I found myself increasingly reliant on stimulants, namely caffeine. I thought the more caffeine I drank, the more I could do, and the faster I could do it. It worked for a bit, but it also came with increased stress, anxiety, and sleep and gut issues. My career wasn’t just about hours worked, but the quality of ideas I brought to it. I found that being mildly anxious all the time killed my creativity, and I began to explore a morning ritual that wasn’t just a vessel for high amounts of caffeine. I started to look at caffeine as a drug, and treated dosage as an important factor in how I consumed it. Ultimately, I arrived at a combination of cacao and masala chai—which I loved—and a blend of functional mushrooms, each with benefits that aligned with my lifestyle. I had no intention of starting a CPG business (I thought I was going to build an app), but I brought this concoction with me everywhere. Through inquisitive coworkers, I realized I wasn’t so different from everyone else. People around me were looking to reduce their caffeine intake, feel less anxious, and be more focused. Those interactions led me to start MUD\WTR in my apartment in Venice Beach. I was in debt and had a $4k credit limit, but I built the brand, put up a site, and started selling. Within six months, we were doing six figures in revenue—and, now, years later, you can find us in Target, Sprouts, and thousands of stores across the country. We’ve launched products that help people unwind and find nourishment, and most recently came full circle by launching a low-caffeine functional coffee aligned with the values and standards that started this all. I view brands as social sculptures that can shift culture in positive ways if done intentionally. Outside of work, I’m a father, a fine artist, and a black belt in jiu-jitsu. I’m interested in radical curiosity, exploring human potential, and building things that feel more human. If that resonates, we’ll probably get along.

# The Biggest Cash Flow Problem Walmart Sellers Face 💸📦 | Sumaiya Islam · LinkedIn · 2026-06-12T00:00:00+00:00

**Sumaiya Islam**: Keyboard Enterprise Limited.

---

The Biggest Cash Flow Problem Walmart Sellers Face 💸📦
Many Walmart sellers believe that more sales automatically mean a healthier business.

But here's the reality:
A business can be growing fast... and still run out of cash.
In fact, cash flow—not sales—is one of the biggest reasons ecommerce businesses struggle to scale.
The Hidden Trap

Imagine your Walmart store is having its best month ever.
Orders are increasing.
Revenue is growing.
Products are selling fast.
Everything looks great.

But behind the scenes, you're facing a problem:
👉 You need to buy more inventory before you've fully received the cash from previous sales.
This is where many Walmart sellers get stuck.
Growth Can Create Cash Flow Pressure

As sales increase, so do expenses:
📦 Inventory purchases
📈 Advertising costs
🚚 Fulfillment fees
↩️ Returns and refunds
💼 Software and operating expenses

The faster you grow, the more cash you need to keep the business moving.
Without proper planning, even profitable businesses can experience cash shortages.
Why Many Sellers Don't See It Coming

Most sellers focus on:
✔️ Revenue
✔️ Orders
✔️ Sales trends

But they often overlook:
❌ Cash available today
❌ Upcoming inventory payments
❌ Advertising commitments
❌ Future operating expenses

The result?
A business that looks successful on paper but struggles to fund its next stage of growth.
The Smart Sellers Focus on Cash Flow First

Successful Walmart sellers regularly monitor:
✅ Inventory turnover
✅ Net profit margins
✅ Upcoming cash requirements
✅ Marketplace payouts
✅ Operating expenses

They understand that cash flow is the fuel that keeps a business running.
Without it, growth can quickly become a burden instead of an opportunity.

The Lesson
Revenue creates excitement.
Profit creates sustainability.
But cash flow creates survival.

Pro Affiliate & Sellers Policy – Goldie Locks Salon Professional® 

## Pro Affiliate & Sellers Policy 

### Goldie Locks® Pro Affiliate & Retail Policy

Welcome to Goldie Locks®. Our journey together is built on a shared commitment to excellence, integrity, and the elevation of our craft. The Pro Affiliate Program is an extension of this partnership, an invitation-only privilege designed to support and reward the talented stylists located in the US who believe in our mission. This policy outlines the principles that protect our collective community and the integrity of the Goldie Locks® brand.

#### 1. Our Foundation: The Retail Integrity Agreement

This is the most crucial pillar of our partnership and is non-negotiable. To protect the premium experience and value of our brand for everyone, Goldie Locks® products may only be sold through the following approved channels:

- Your Physical Salon or Studio: The heart of your client experience.
- Your Personalized Goldie Locks® Pro Affiliate Link: Your unique digital storefront.
- Your Direct Salon or Professional Website: An approved extension of your physical business.

Selling, reselling, or distributing Goldie Locks® products on any third-party marketplace is strictly prohibited at all times. This includes, but is not limited to, platforms such as Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, eBay, or any other online marketplace, mobile app, or physical resale outlet.

Upholding this standard is essential. Any violation will result in immediate termination of your affiliate and wholesale accounts, forfeiture of all pending commissions, and any other actions necessary to protect our brand's integrity.

#### 2. The Heart of the Program: An Invitation to Partnership

The Goldie Locks® Pro Affiliate Program is a testament to our belief in you. It was created to provide our US based professional community with the ability to serve their clients beyond the chair, ensuring you are rewarded when they shop directly with us. This program is designed to complement your in-salon retail success, not replace it.

Participation is a privilege extended to our active and valued wholesale partners. It is your responsibility to remain in good standing and to foster a positive representation of the Goldie Locks® community. We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to approve, deny, or remove any affiliate from the program who does not align with our brand values or adhere to these policies.

#### 3. The Rhythm of Rewards: Commissions & Payouts

We believe in celebrating your success consistently. Here’s how our commission process works:

- Monthly Payouts: Payouts for all approved, qualified commissions are processed once per month, typically within the first week of the month, for the prior month's activity.
- Qualified Commissions: A commission is considered "qualified" after it has cleared any potential fraud checks and the return period has passed.
- Returns & Adjustments: Our commitment is to real, tangible sales. If a customer returns a product for which you have already earned a commission, a corresponding deduction will be made from your subsequent commission payout. We strive to make this process transparent within your affiliate dashboard.

#### 4. Your Responsibilities: Maintaining a Healthy Partnership

To ensure the vitality of this program for everyone, your active participation is key.

- Account Activity: The Pro Affiliate Program is for our active wholesale partners. Maintaining an active wholesale account, with purchasing activity, is required to keep your affiliate privileges. We review account activity periodically to ensure the program remains exclusive to our practicing professional community.

# How We Hit 6 Figures in The First Year of Business

Check out Daily Crunch's interview and feature in Project Hatch!

How We Hit 6 Figures in The First Year of Business 

Rachel Steinford

21 Oct 2020

Daily Crunch Snacks is a brand new line of sprouted almond snacks, available in 3 varieties: Just Sprouted Almonds, Coffee-Soaked, and a Nut-Berry Medley. The products are currently available at a number of retailers and independent stores across the nation. Sprouting is a process of soaking nuts to reduce phytic acid, making the nuts more easily digestible while maintaining all nutritional value.

Daily Crunch goes beyond the normal soaking process and follows it up with a dehydration of the nuts. This creates a Uniquely Crunchy™ texture, making the product stand out amongst the other nuts on the shelf, not to mention its bright branding which is sure to catch your eye.

## Was it a lightbulb moment or gradual moment to start Daily Crunch Snacks?

We all have ideas, but acting on them is a different story. After a corporate career working for the #2 largest advertiser in the world, for the first time in my career I felt lost. I thought I didn’t know anything but corporate culture life, but I didn’t realize that feeling vulnerable was actually what led me to finding my path as co-founder of Daily Crunch Snacks. I knew I wanted to start my own company, but needed to figure out what that was. I kept going back to my husband’s aunt’s sprouted nuts that she’s been gifting to friends and family the past 10+ years. There was nothing like them in the mainstream market. I called Diane back in November, 2018 asked if she wanted to be business partners. The rest is history!

## How did you validate the idea? Did you have any experience/expertise in the area?

After more than a year in the pre-launch phase, we were finally ready to start selling Daily Crunch. Our go-to-launch strategy was to go big in Nashville and Detroit, where Diane and I are based, before expanding nationally. I set up a lot of meetings in Nashville, where I was connected to the owner of Citizen Market in East Nashville. I remember having the meeting with her and her placing our 1st order. I wanted to jump on the table and scream. I was so excited, but instead tried to act as professional as possible. There is such a great feeling getting orders from people who aren’t friends and family and truly love your product. After meeting with her, I started to get more confident reaching out to local Nashville stores and pitching Daily Crunch.

## Who is your target demographic?

Our target are Women 25-54+, primarily busy moms with kids 3-12 and millennials who are on the go. I learned very quickly that if we were not very specific about targeting our key consumers of slightly older millennials and busy moms, then we would lose sight of who we are. The former COO of RXBar told me that we need to find a micro target and build off of that - the same way they started with targeting Crossfit members. We are currently building micro-targets in the FOODmap, KETO and gut healthy world with our nutritionist to educate these targets on the benefits of sprouting.

## Where did you meet your co-founder/founding team?

Diane Orley, my co-founder has been perfecting the sprouting process for 15 years, after discovering the process in India. I’m a mother of three and CPG vet with 13 years of advertising experience working with Unilever. COO Dan Stephenson is an entrepreneur that came from the finance world and gained experience in the natural CPG space with his line of frozen artisan mac & cheeses under the Dan’s Gourmet brand. I found Dan through EO (entrepreneurs Organization) during our pre-launch phase when we needed a consultant to help us.

We worked really well together and he had so much expertise in the grocery world that Diane and I didn't have, that asking him to become our 3rd partner was only the natural fit.

Daily Crunch About Us - Daily Crunch

### SNACKS THAT TASTE AS GOOD AS THEY MAKE YOU FEEL.

co-founded in 2020

### How it all started...

Over 15 years ago, Diane, Laurel’s aunt & co-founder, started sprouting almonds—soaking them, then dehydrating instead of roasting with oils. Diane added real ingredients to create delicious flavors. The result? Seriously crunchy nuts.

Her niece Laurel, a health-conscious foodie with a background in marketing, was obsessed and saw the potential to introduce a clean and satisfying snack that her family and others could enjoy. After perfecting this new snack they launched Daily Crunch in March 2020—bringing clean, seed oil-free snacks to life!

Daily Crunch is a women-owned, mission-driven snack brand crafting Uniquely Crunchy™ sprouted nut snacks that taste as good as they make you feel.

### Our Uniquely Crunchy™ Process

At Daily Crunch, we begin by sprouting our nuts — soaking them to enhance their texture. Then, instead of roasting, we gently dehydrate them to preserve their natural flavor and deliver our signature Uniquely Crunchy™ bite.

Our patented process is completely seed oil-free, meaning no seed or palm oils are ever used. Why does that matter? Many seed oils can be highly processed and high in omega-6 fats, which can contribute to inflammation when consumed in excess. By skipping seed oils altogether, we keep our snacks cleaner, lighter, and better for you — without sacrificing flavor or crunch.

## Best Sellers

### WE GIVE BACK!

At Daily Crunch, we believe that mental health should be as much a part of the fabric of our daily lives as the food we eat. In support of our mission that is very close to the founders of Daily Crunch, a portion of all Daily Crunch proceeds go to The Support Network, which advocates mental health awareness on college campuses.

companySourceDocs.title: Forecasting Isn't About Predicting the Future, It's About Alignment
companySourceDocs.text:
# A client once asked me why they were constantly running out of inventory. | Josh S. · LinkedIn · 2026-06-10T00:00:00+00:00

**Josh S.**: Fulfillment @ Ancient Crunch | Making Real, Nutrient-Dense Food More Accessible | Scaling DTC & Wholesale.

---

A client once asked me why they were constantly running out of inventory.

The answer surprised them.

It wasn't because the forecast was wrong.

It was because everyone had a different forecast.

Here's what I found...

Marketing was planning for 30% growth.

Finance was planning for 10%.

Operations was planning for supplier delays.

The warehouse was planning for whatever showed up.

Same company.

Four different futures.

How did they get there?

Nobody was intentionally creating problems.

Everyone was doing what they thought was right.

Marketing built campaigns around an aggressive growth target.

Finance wanted to protect cash.

Operations had been burned by stockouts before.

So each department quietly adjusted the numbers to fit their reality.

Then the consequences started showing up.

❌ Inventory arriving too early.

❌ Inventory arriving too late.

❌ Production schedules changing weekly.

❌ Rush freight costs increasing.

❌ Teams blaming each other for missed expectations.

The crazy part?

The forecast itself wasn't the problem.

The lack of alignment was.

Because forecasting isn't really about predicting the future.

It's about getting everyone to agree on which future they're planning for.

So what did we do?

✅ Put every department in the same planning meeting.

✅ Created one forecast everyone could see.

✅ Documented the assumptions behind the numbers.

✅ Reviewed forecast changes weekly.

✅ Forced disagreements to happen before inventory was ordered.

Within a few months, the planning process became dramatically less chaotic.

Everyone was finally working from the same version of reality.

That's the part of forecasting a lot don't realize.

The spreadsheet isn't the hard part.

Getting PEOPLE to agree on the future is.

And that's usually where operational problems begin.

## Comments

**Maddy Sukoru** · 2026-06-10T00:00:00+00:00
> As they say in Hollywood, we are in the people business.

**Hamza Khan** · 2026-06-10T00:00:00+00:00
> Marketing planning for 30% growth while finance plans for 10% and nobody told the warehouse. Seen this exact situation. The inventory pays for the disagreement.

## About

McKenzie Turley, a true pioneer in the hair extension industry and the founder of Invisible Bead Extensions (IBE®), a game-changing method for hand-tied weft installation that has taken the industry by storm. With an industry-first patented method, clients can now enjoy true flexibility and comfort without risk of exposing their extension secrets. McKenzie’s method offers the first-ever invisible extension method with seamless flip-ups and healthy grow-outs. Her priority has always been her clients’ comfort and safety, which grew into educating stylists to prioritize the same for their guests. To best educate and prepare stylists for their advancing careers, she began offering the first-of-its-kind, high-definition virtual education across the country and globe. Since its conception, thousands of stylists have been certified in IBE®, forever changing the lives of women and their confidence. McKenzie has created multiple solutions for stylists by offering three different luxury extension hairlines featuring dozens of colors, lengths, and textures. She has also designed tools and accessories unique to the market, allowing stylists to achieve the highest level of precision and accuracy behind the chair. She holds a United States patent for her revolutionary co-design of a unique Velcro hair grip utilized by extension artists during their installs. Her extensive innovations in the extension industry permit the utmost customization for stylists to create, making her a sought-after expert in her field. Not only has McKenzie revolutionized the hair extension world with her patented method and virtual education, she has also created a one-of-a-kind in-person education center catering to hair stylists of all learning types. Stylists can visit the IBE® Education Center in St. George, Utah, and immerse themselves in hands-on training, furthering their knowledge and understanding of the complexities of the hair extension industry. McKenzie is not just a successful businesswoman; she is also a true champion of healthy hair. After dealing with significant hair loss firsthand, she realized a need for higher-quality ingredients to heal the hair strand from root to tip. Jan 21, 2021 1 min read

# GoodJanes Founder Weighs In On Sephora’s And Ulta Beauty’s Big Retail Partnerships

In this edition of Beauty Independent’s ongoing series posing questions to beauty entrepreneurs, we ask 28 founders and executives: What do you think of the recently revealed partnerships between Ulta Beauty and Target, and Sephora and Kohl’s? How do you predict they will change the retail landscape and the beauty industry?

 JANELLE FRIEDMAN Founder, Good Janes 

> The partnerships between the major chains and the big beauty retailers are a sign of the times. While the sales in the big beauty retailers have declined, the partnerships with the major chains gives them more exposure to more customers and an opportunity to sell more product. It can be very beneficial. It can also give new customers a new experience and give the beauty retailers more brand awareness. 
> 
> It is what the big cosmetic companies have been doing in major department stores for years. We think the retail landscape is in the process of changing for the better. As a result of these partnerships, beauty products will become more accessible and less expensive. More women and men will enjoy the products that companies like ours have to offer.

Continue reading on Beauty Independent.

#### Full job description

We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

## About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our supply chain has to move faster than the demand. As our Supply Chain Specialist, you'll be the execution engine behind it: owning purchase orders from creation to receipt, keeping inventory and inbound data airtight, and catching risk before it ever reaches a customer. You'll work side by side with our Director of Supply Chain and directly with our suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and the work you do will protect product availability as we grow.

 This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

## In this role, you will:

- Own day-to-day purchase order execution, moving every PO through production, shipment, receipt, and exception resolution without dropped follow-up
- Run the operating cadence with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs, so every confirmation, delay, decision, and committed date has one clear owner: you
- Maintain the source of truth for available, inbound, and at-risk inventory, so the team always knows what we have, what's coming, and what's in trouble
- Spot shortages, production delays, material constraints, freight risk, and inventory imbalances early, and escalate with a recommended action, not just a flag
- Build Claude-powered workflows that turn raw PO, inventory, production, and freight data into exception lists, supplier communications, meeting recaps, and decision-ready summaries
- Standardize reporting, documentation, and recurring workflows (and write the SOPs) so the team can handle higher volume with fewer manual errors

## We're looking for someone who:

- Has 1-3 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, logistics, or inventory management, working close to the physical flow of product rather than only reporting on it
- Has worked in or around a fast-paced CPG, food/beverage, supplements, wellness, beauty, or other physical-product business (strongly preferred)
- Has coordinated directly with external suppliers, manufacturers, or logistics partners, whether in a full-time role or internship, and held them to deadlines across multiple workstreams at once
- Has hands-on experience with an ERP, inventory, or order management system (NetSuite-style) and can pull and organize clean source data without help
- Uses Claude or other AI tools daily for real operational work: writes strong prompts, builds reusable workflows, and validates outputs against source data before acting on them
- Can point to real examples of catching a problem early and driving it to resolution

## Approach to the role:

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of what matters most to the business
- Proactive: follows up before the deadline, not after something is already late
- Comfortable in ambiguity, and builds structure where processes are still taking shape
- Takes extreme ownership: closes loops and communicates risk early
- Collaborative and low-ego, while still holding internal teams and external partners accountable
- Treats AI as a force multiplier on the work, never a substitute for judgment

About Us - Learn About Our Mission & Innovation | Cadence 

##### Note from our founder

 We are a design company based in Brooklyn New York – woman founded, run, and AAPI owned.We believe the world deserves better products, and when everything has a place – you have space to focus on life, in Cadence. Warmly,Steph - Founder & CEO 

##### WHAT WE BELIEVE

 

## Great products build great brands.

Many companies build brand first, and product second. We don’t prescribe to this belief. We grow deliberately so we never sacrifice the qualities that make people feel proud to choose us. We dream without constraints or margin targets, because we believe great products sell itself. 

 

## Support autonomy.

We do not define what someone’s best self looks like, or how they should organize their life. There is no single right system, routine, or standard. We will always sell individual products, so you can buy only and exactly what you need now and in the future.

 

## Holding the standard.

Every decision, from materials to messaging, should strengthen the product and the system as a whole. If something compromises the experience, it is a no. We will never launch a product before it’s ready or source something that already exits – anything we put out in the world is uniquely ours. 

 

## There's always a way.

We do not accept conventions as a starting point. Rules aren’t always right. We ask whether a problem truly deserves solving, and how it could be approached more thoughtfully.

 

## Reduce friction to make room for what matters

People are not limited by capability, but by the invisible work of managing everyday life. We design to remove that friction, so their time and attention can be spent more meaningfully.
