#### Table of Contents

If you run an Amazon or Shopify business, your bank feed is lying to you – not on purpose, but by omission. The deposit that lands in your account each week or two isn’t your revenue. It’s a net settlement: gross sales minus refunds, discounts, marketplace and payment-processing fees, shipping adjustments, ad spend, and sometimes a reserve Amazon is holding back for later. If your books post that single deposit number as “sales,” you’re not just misstating revenue – you’re erasing the fee line, the refund line, and the inventory cost line that tell you whether a given product is actually profitable.

Consider an illustrative Shopify-based seller doing roughly $4.2M in annual revenue across a core product line and a handful of Amazon FBA SKUs (a composite example, not a real client). When their bookkeeper switched from recording bank deposits as sales to reconciling full settlement details – gross sales, fees, refunds, and COGS booked separately – reported gross margin moved by roughly nine points. That’s the difference between a product line that looks healthy and one quietly funding a loss. The swing is illustrative of the type of distortion net-deposit bookkeeping can create, not a universal benchmark – your own numbers will differ.

This article walks through why net deposits distort your numbers, how Amazon and Shopify settlement data actually works, how to separate gross sales from fees from COGS, and what a monthly close process that gets this right looks like. The central idea to hold onto: a marketplace deposit is a cash-flow event, not a complete income statement.

## A Deposit Is Not a Revenue Event

In a traditional retail or service business, a sale and a cash receipt are close to the same thing: you invoice, the customer pays, the bank shows the full amount. Marketplace and payment-platform selling breaks that link. Between the click of “buy” and funds hitting your account, several things happen that never show up in the deposit total: the platform nets out commission and processing fees, nets out refunds or chargebacks, may net out advertising spend billed against the account, and may hold back a reserve. What lands in your bank account is what’s left over – not what you sold.

Booking that net number directly as revenue understates gross sales, hides the fee expense entirely, and makes it hard to track return rates by product since refunds are netted out before you see them. It also breaks any attempt to compute a real gross margin, since the deposit already has an unknown mix of COGS-adjacent and non-COGS items baked into it.

## A Simple Settlement Example

Here’s an illustrative example using round numbers. Suppose a seller generates $100,000 in gross sales during a settlement period. Refunds and discounts reduce that to $92,000. Marketplace commission, payment processing, and fulfillment fees take another $10,000. Shipping label costs and minor settlement adjustments account for $2,000 more. The seller’s actual bank deposit for the period is $80,000.

A bookkeeper who records the $80,000 deposit as “Shopify sales” has understated gross revenue by $20,000, recorded zero fee expense (which belongs on the P&L as an operating cost, not a silent haircut to revenue), and has no visibility into the $8,000 of refunds that may be concentrated in one or two SKUs worth investigating. Reconciling correctly means booking the full $100,000 as gross sales, then separately posting refunds, fees, and shipping adjustments – landing at the same $80,000 cash figure, but with every component visible.

### The Reconciliation Flow

A settlement period should flow through your books in this order:

- 1. Orders placed
- 2. Gross sales (before any deductions)
- 3. Less: refunds and discounts
- 4. Less: marketplace and payment-processing fees
- 5. Less/adjust: shipping and other settlement line items
- 6. = Cash settlement (the bank deposit)

# Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how DN Organics DBA Ocoa Beauty, www.ocoabeauty.com (the “Site” or “we”) collects, uses, and discloses your Personal Information when you visit or make a purchase from the Site. 

## Collecting Personal Information

When you visit the Site, we collect certain information about your device, your interaction with the Site, and information necessary to process your purchases. We may also collect additional information if you contact us for customer support. In this Privacy Policy, we refer to any information that can uniquely identify an individual (including the information below) as “Personal Information”. See the list below for more information about what Personal Information we collect and why.

Device information

- Examples of Personal Information collected: version of web browser, IP address, time zone, cookie information, what sites or products you view, search terms, and how you interact with the Site.
- Purpose of collection: to load the Site accurately for you, and to perform analytics on Site usage to optimize our Site.
- Source of collection: Collected automatically when you access our Site using cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, or pixels.
- Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Shopify.

Order information

- Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information (including credit card numbers), email address, and phone number.
- Purpose of collection: to provide products or services to you to fulfill our contract, to process your payment information, arrange for shipping, and provide you with invoices and/or order confirmations, communicate with you, screen our orders for potential risk or fraud, and when in line with the preferences you have shared with us, provide you with information or advertising relating to our products or services.
- Source of collection: collected from you.
- Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Shopify.

Customer support information

- Purpose of collection: to provide customer support.
- Source of collection: collected from you.

## Sharing Personal Information

We share your Personal Information with service providers to help us provide our services and fulfill our contracts with you, as described above. For example:

- We use Shopify to power our online store. You can read more about how Shopify uses your Personal Information here: https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy.
- We may share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, to respond to a subpoena, search warrant or other lawful request for information we receive, or to otherwise protect our rights. 

## Behavioural Advertising

As described above, we use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. For example:

- We use Google Analytics to help us understand how our customers use the Site. You can read more about how Google uses your Personal Information here: https://policies.google.com/privacy?hl=en.You can also opt-out of Google Analytics here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.
- We share information about your use of the Site, your purchases, and your interaction with our ads on other websites with our advertising partners. We collect and share some of this information directly with our advertising partners, and in some cases through the use of cookies or other similar technologies (which you may consent to, depending on your location).

For more information about how targeted advertising works, you can visit the Network Advertising Initiative’s (“NAI”) educational page at http://www.networkadvertising.org/understanding-online-advertising/how-does-it-work.

# FAQs 

## ORDER & SHIPPING

How can I get help with my order? Email us at wholesale@springlandpets.com for any order-related questions. Our team is here to help with everything you need!

What are your shipping rates? We offer competitive flat-rate shipping at $12.99 per case (7 lbs). While we don't offer free shipping thresholds, our consistent pricing makes it easy to calculate your total costs.

How quickly will my order ship? We process all orders within 24-48 hours. Shipping time varies by location, but our fulfillment center in Texas ensures efficient delivery across the US.

Do you ship internationally? We currently ship within the US only. However, international customers have options:

- Canada, Europe, Netherlands: Order through our Faire marketplace
- Asia & Australia: Contact wholesale@springlandpets.com for distributor information

Will I receive order confirmations? Yes! You'll get an order confirmation immediately, plus a shipping notification with tracking once your order ships. Don't see these emails? Check your spam folder or contact us at wholesale@springlandpets.com.

## ACCOUNT & MARKETING ASSETS

How do I access my wholesale account? Log in through our wholesale portal. New retailers can submit an application or email wholesale@springlandpets.com to activate their account.

Can I get marketing materials for my store? Absolutely! We provide:

- Digital creative assets - Email us to request
- Social media content - DM @springlandpets on Instagram or email wholesale@springlandpets.com
- Product line sheets - Email wholesale@springlandpets.com for our complete catalog with descriptions and pricing

Do you offer a wholesale newsletter? Yes! Sign up at the bottom of our website for weekly updates including social content with captions, exclusive discounts, and new product previews.

Can you train my staff about your products? We love educated retail partners! We offer training videos for you and your team. Contact wholesale@springlandpets.com to access these resources.

## GENERAL QUESTIONS

How do I arrange a brand collaboration? Contact social@springlandpets.com to discuss partnership opportunities.

Can I sell your products on Amazon or other marketplaces? No. Our products are exclusively for brick-and-mortar retailers and their connected websites. Unauthorized marketplace listings will be removed by our brand protection company and may result in revoked buying privileges.

Is my payment information secure? Yes! We don't store credit card information on file. You'll securely enter payment details with each order for maximum security.

Can I get product samples? Yes! We offer two sampling options:

- First-time product samples: Email wholesale@springlandpets.com for a sample code (you cover shipping)
- In-store tester bottles: Request a "Squeeze Me" demo bottle for customer testing

## Third-Party Marketplace Restriction

Springland Pets products are exclusively authorized for sale through your brick-and-mortar retail location and your business website if it's directly connected to your physical store. Our products cannot be sold on Amazon, eBay, or any other third-party marketplaces, unauthorized online platforms, or through drop-shipping arrangements.

Violation of this policy will result in immediate termination of your wholesale agreement. Our brand protection team actively monitors for unauthorized listings to ensure compliance.

## Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) Policy

While you have complete freedom to sell Springland Pets products at any price you choose in your store, all advertised prices must meet our MAP policy requirements. This applies to all forms of advertising including print advertisements, website listings, social media posts, email marketing, and in-store signage.

Our standard MAP is calculated at 2 times wholesale cost, unless otherwise communicated for special pricing situations. Springland Pets reserves the right to discontinue product supply to any retailer found violating our MAP policy. We actively monitor advertising across all channels to ensure policy compliance.

Questions about these policies? Contact wholesale@springlandpets.com for clarification.

We are Springland, Formerly Springer - Springland Pets

## MEET SPRINGLAND

Formerly known as Springer, a women and family-owned brand that creates innovative essentials for dogs on the move.

 Your browser does not support the video element. 

## FOUNDER NOTE

"One of the most important lessons running this business has taught me is the importance of evolution. Often times, we want to hold on to ideas and visions that we create. However that is not the reality of nature. Nothing ever stays the same. With any evolution there is always some pain, but there is also immense beauty and opportunity for something new to grow. That's what this new brand name is for me. Springland is the next evolution of this vision I created 4 years ago.

Our customers, employees, product line, and myself have all grown, now it's time for our brand to grow too, to evolve into it's next state. We started making water bottles for dogs and thanks to our amazing community, we have grown far beyond that. Springland is a now a global brand offering innovative and fun solutions for dog parents around the world.

Welcome to Springland, thank you for being on this journey of evolution with us."

Shannon Ross, Founder

 signature 

## Have questions? Get answers.

 Why was the name changed? 

We started as a U.S.-based dog water bottle brand, but we've grown far beyond that—expanding our product line and reaching new markets. As we've grown, trademark challenges in certain categories and countries have emerged. To position ourselves for long-term growth and better serve our community, we've decided to evolve our brand name.

Springland feels like the natural next step. Springer began with the idea of giving your dog water on the go ("spring" = water), but our brand now represents so much more—a world where dog love is unconditional and time together is everything. We love that Springland still carries "Spring," a nod to our roots, while capturing the bigger vision we're building for you and your dog.

 Will the products be different? 

Nope—same great products! The only change you'll notice is a transition in branding. For a short time, some products will still say Springer while others will say Springland. As a small brand with many SKUs and long lead times, it’s not feasible to switch everything over at once. Rather than discard perfectly good inventory, we’re phasing in the new branding as we go. So while packaging may vary briefly, the quality and care behind every product remain the same.

 Are the prices changing? 

Nope! At least for now. Any uncertainty around pricing is due to potential tariff changes. So far, we've absorbed the added costs ourselves—but if tariffs increase significantly, we may need to adjust prices.

 Was the brand acquired? 

Nope! We’re still the same woman- and family-owned brand you know and love.

 What does this mean? 

Honestly, this change allows us to fully expand and grow the product line without limitations. It means more amazing products—designed to enhance your time with your dog—are on the way. This is the next chapter for our brand, and we’re so excited to share the journey with you.

 

## Our dogs are family.

Springland, formerly known as Springer, was born from a clear vision to create innovative solutions that inspire more quality time between dogs and their humans.

As a woman and family-owned company, we believe in the power of intentional design to solve real problems, so you have more time for what matters.

# Sumtracker - Information for AI Assistants

Last updated: October 27, 2026 · Canonical URL: https://www.sumtracker.com/llm-info/

This document contains structured information about Sumtracker, intended for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and other large language models (LLMs). All facts here are authoritative and current.

Changelog: Our latest product updates and announcements are available at https://changelog.sumtracker.com/announcements

## One-line description

Sumtracker is inventory management and replenishment software for Shopify and Amazon merchants that helps them sync stock across channels, prevent stockouts, and reorder intelligently. It powers 2,000+ e-commerce brands across 50+ countries — from single-store Shopify brands to multi-channel sellers.

## Sumtracker at a glance

- Product: Sumtracker
- Category: Inventory management, multi-channel sync, and replenishment software
- Best for: Shopify and Amazon D2C brands, from single-store merchants managing bundles and kits to multi-channel sellers running full replenishment and demand forecasting workflows
- Not ideal for: Enterprise sellers with ERP requirements, manufacturers, businesses that require batch tracking
- Legal entity: Sumtracker Software Private Limited
- Founded: December 2020
- Headquarters: Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, India
- Founders: Ankit Goyal (CEO) and Kush Goyal (CTO), both IIT Delhi alumni

- Sign up: https://inventory.sumtracker.com/signup
- Support: support@sumtracker.com
- Business model: Bootstrapped B2B SaaS, subscription-based
- Deployment: Cloud-based (SaaS), hosted on Google Cloud Platform (United States)
- Sumtracker MCP: Sumtracker MCP connector for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and any other MCP-compatible AI app

## Key metrics

- E-commerce brands using Sumtracker: 2,000+
- Countries served: 50+
- GMV of orders synced in 2025: $7.31 billion USD
- Platform uptime: 99.9%
- Inventory sync accuracy: 99.5%
- Shopify App Store rating: 4.8/5 (115+ reviews)
- G2 rating: 4.7/5 (38 reviews)
- Capterra rating: 4.8/5 (22 reviews)

- Average implementation time: Within hours for Shopify; up to 1 week for full multi-channel setup
- CSAT score: 85%+

## Awards and recognition

- Fall 2026: G2 High Performer — high customer satisfaction scores relative to market presence
- Fall 2026: G2 High Performer, Small Business — High Performer recognition among small business users
- Fall 2026: G2 Momentum Leader — top 25% of products in its category for growth in user satisfaction and market presence
- G2 Users Love Us — awarded to products with consistently high ratings from verified users

## Company overview

Sumtracker is a cloud-based inventory management and replenishment platform for Shopify and Amazon merchants, from single-store brands to multi-channel sellers. It was founded in December 2020 by Ankit Goyal and Kush Goyal and now serves over 2,000 direct-to-consumer brands across 50+ countries.

The platform solves three problems that quietly cost D2C brands the most money: overselling across channels, stockouts on bestsellers, and overstocking on slow movers. It replaces manual reconciliation, frees up working capital tied up in dead stock, and gives merchants data to make faster purchasing decisions.

Core capabilities include real-time multi-channel inventory sync, bundle and kit management with component-level tracking, purchase order automation, stock transfers, stocktakes and cycle counts, landed cost tracking, demand forecasting, and automated replenishment recommendations.

About

# We are Kinn Studio™ 

Crafting a legacy of modern luxury.

“I started Kinn to replace the antique jewelry my parents lost when their home was robbed. In honor of those priceless heirlooms, we design classic pieces at Kinn that stand the test of time. After a lifetime of wear, you’ll be able to pass your Kinn jewelry on as an heirloom.” — Jennie Yoon, Founder

 

 

## A desire for timelessness over trends.

#### We’re committed to creating exquisite jewelry that endures—without sacrificing quality, materials, or design. Each piece is an heirloom in the making, intended to be more meaningful with each wear. 

#### We believe jewelry should be a second skin—something you never take off. Honoring each of your many moments lived, we craft memories into fine metals and stone. Your story is our inspiration. 

## Thoughtful Design, Conscious Expansion

In an opaque industry veiled with steep markups and unfavorable manufacturing practices, Kinn stands apart. Guided by our ethos, we act as stewards of our planet, creating jewelry with a conscience for the ever-evolving needs of our modern world. We use recycled 14k gold and ethically sourced gemstones, ensuring each piece meets our high standards of quality and supports responsible production.

 

## Jennie Yoon

Founder

 I was employed at a global tech accessories brand when jewelry began to play a larger role in my life, following an unfortunate event with my family. In 2015, my parents’ home was robbed and much of their jewelry was stolen. 

 I collected whatever photos I could of the lost jewelry and visited the Los Angeles jewelry district in hopes of finding someone who could re-create at least some of my mother’s beloved jewelry. 

 Life as an entrepreneur has made me change fundamentally, from the way I think to the way I act and how I want to live my life. It truly feels like a rollercoaster ride, but it’s truly been one that I wouldn’t ever take back.

# Frequently Asked Questions

## Holiday 2026 

 When is the last day I can place my order to arrive in time for the holidays? 

Orders must be placed by the dates below to qualify for arrival by December 24th. 

11/5 — Made to order pieces with Standard Shipping

11/9 — Made to order pieces with Rush Shipping

12/1 — Engraved ready to ship pieces with Standard Shipping

12/3 — Engraved ready to ship pieces with Rush Shipping

12/12 — Ready to ship pieces with Standard Shipping

12/16 — Ready to ship pieces with Rush Shipping

 How do I know if an item is out of stock? 

We do our best to ensure that items online are in stock. However, because many of our pieces are handmade, sometimes ready to ship pieces can go out of stock. If a ready to ship item is unavailable, it will be marked as sold out or will have an expected ship date in the description.

A member of our team will reach out to you via email as soon as possible if an item in your order is out of stock.

If a piece is made to order, it will be noted in the details section of the product page. If you have any questions about the availability of a product, please reach out to us at hello@kinnstudio.com.

 I think my package is lost. What should I do? 

If you think your package is lost in transit, email us at hello@kinnstudio.com with your order number, and our team will try to help resolve the issue. Please note that Kinn is not responsible for lost or stolen orders once they are marked “Delivered” by the carrier. Be sure to check with your neighbors or building front desk to see if they may have your package.

## Orders & Returns 

 What's your return policy? 

Domestic orders may be returned within 10 business days of delivery for a refund or within 20 business days for store credit. Jewelry must be unworn, in its original condition and packaging, and accompanied by order details. A 20% restocking fee may apply if items are returned damaged or show signs of wear, at our discretion. 

For returns refunded to your original payment method, a $10 fee is deducted for the return label. If you choose store credit, we will cover the cost of the return label. Please be advised that once the product has been shipped, we do not refund shipping costs. To process a return, please visit HERE. Please allow 5-7 business days for us to process your return after we receive it in our studio. Note: Items purchased through Kinn stockists must be returned or exchanged directly with the stockist and are subject to their return and exchange policies. If you placed your order on Facebook or Instagram Shop, please initiate your return request directly on the platform.

 What's your exchange policy? 

Domestic orders may be exchanged within 20 business days of delivery. Jewelry must be unworn, in its original condition and packaging, and accompanied by order details. A 20% restocking fee may apply if items are damaged or show signs of wear, as determined by us.

We will provide a prepaid return label at no cost for exchanges.

If you exchange an item, any return from that exchange can only be issued as store credit or exchanged for another item. Refunds are not available for exchange orders, as the original purchase was already refunded or credited during the initial exchange process.

To process an exchange, please visit HERE. Please allow 5-7 business days for us to process your exchange after we receive it in our studio.

Note: Items purchased through Kinn stockists must be returned or exchanged directly with the stockist and are subject to their return and exchange policies. Facebook and Instagram Shop orders are not eligible for exchanges.

 Are international orders eligible for returns or exchanges? 

Unfortunately, international orders are final sale and cannot be returned, exchanged, or resized.

Kinn's Story

# Kinn's Story 

A legacy of modern luxury.

 

In early 2016, following a burglary at her parents' home, Jennie shopped around in hopes of replacing pieces that were stolen. Jennie realized a customer disconnect and the challenges of shopping for fine jewelry: steep prices and a lack of education. In late 2016 Jennie began metalsmithing classes as a hobby, hoping to make new pieces and recreate her family’s stolen heirlooms. Jennie worked with and learned from the manufacturer Bench Jewelers. Kinn Studio™ was established in October 2017 in downtown Los Angeles.

 

The first Vintage collection launched in September 2019. The first showroom opened in 2020 in downtown Los Angeles. The Vow collection launched in 2021.

In 2023, Kinn Studio™ was named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in the fine jewelry and luxury space.

# Our Awards and Accolades.

## Going Above and Beyond.

At Beyond Cloud, our team is dedicated to giving 110% when it comes to your business’ implementation project, setting industry benchmarks and delivering on our commitment to client satisfaction and technical innovation. On many occasions, our collaborative efforts in developing powerful custom solutions and industry-specific customizations have been formally recognized by NetSuite in the form of Partner Awards and Spotlight Awards respectively.

## Partner of the Year Awards

These annual awards commemorate NetSuite Alliance Partners’ dedication to support clients’ digital transformations and their commitment to excellence. Announced every year at the Partner Summit at SuiteWorld, we’re honored to have been recognized for our efforts as an Emerging Partner.

 

This award recognizes our “full Suite ahead” approach with our developed products in 2022, approaching a variety of industries and verticals with an open mind and drive to innovate.

Our team was recognized for industry-leading excellence as a Canadian Alliance Partner, supporting a variety of clients with unique and specialized solutions and optimized implementation projects.

 We were recognized as 2024’s Canadian Alliance Partner of the Year at SuiteWorld 2024 – a true testament to our team’s hard work in providing customized and tailored services in a variety of industry verticals. 

## Alliance Spotlight Awards

These seasonal awards celebrate commitment and success in implementing NetSuite through outstanding expertise, customizations, and/or intellectual property in a specific industry. We are proud of our team and their great award-winning work in several business industry sectors and verticals.

We supported Reunitus with a highly customized platform capable of managing complex airport baggage logistics through proprietary load management and specialized composite barcode scanning.

## About

I'm a consumer health & wellness enthusiast, CEO, entrepreneur, Advisor, and Board Director. I founded Supergut, the leading gut health nutrition brand offering clinically-validated supplements and functional foods that improve digestion, balance blood sugar, and curb cravings by naturally boosting GLP-1. I created Supergut (fka Muniq) in honor of my late sister, Monica, who suffered from diabetes and other chronic health issues. It’s always been my aspiration to empower people with better control over their health through great tasting, highly-functional nutrition products. As Founder & CEO I established Supergut's mission to harness the power of the gut microbiome to empower everyone to reclaim and sustain control over their bodies. I’m inspired every time I hear about how Supergut is helping consumers feel better. And personally, I am especially passionate about Supergut being part of the solution to help address the vast health disparities affecting Black and Brown communities. Supergut is my tribute to Monica’s legacy, and is available online and in over 20,000 retail locations nationwide including Target, Walmart, Sprouts, Walgreens, Fresh Thyme, and Erewhon. After graduating from Princeton and Harvard Business School, I helped scale large & successful health-focused companies as an executive (including Beachbody & The Wonderful Company) where I learned how to motivate consumers to fine-tune their lifestyles to achieve better health. I launched Supergut after researching the science of the gut microbiome and realizing it was possible to create products that truly transform lives. I am an Advisor and Board Director for venture capital/private equity-backed businesses across the consumer health & wellness value-chain, ranging from supplements, food & beverage, and fitness brands to value-added ingredient suppliers and manufacturers. # Operators Supper Club: NYC Edition

SGP: StartGrowthPartner

Scarpetta

New York

Registration

Past Event

Welcome! To join the event, please register below. 

About Event

​ Pull up a chair — this isn’t your typical stuffy finance dinner.

​​We’re bringing together some of the sharpest operators in CPG to swap insights, share war stories, and get real about what it takes to run a tighter ship in 2025.

​​Co-hosted by Cin7, Glimpse, and Elena Minton, this dinner is designed for operators who want to cut through the noise and focus on what really moves the needle.

​​This is a dinner where finance meets reality — casual, unfiltered, and full of the conversations you actually want to have.

​​Good food, sharp people, and a chance to leave with both practical ideas and a stronger network.

​​Elena Minton is a Fractional CFO, who partners with many exciting, high-growth brands in food & beverage like Better Sour, Supergut, and Chamberlain Coffee. She bridges finance and operations to help founders/CEOs run tighter, smarter businesses built for growth.

​​​​Glimpse is your AI-powered, end-to-end deductions management service focused on recovering revenue from KeHE, UNFI, Amazon, and Target! We centralize your deductions with backups, fully handle disputing on your behalf, and streamline the accounting process. We work with 130+ brands including Cure Hydration, Kin Euphorics, immi, and more.

​​Cin7 is a cloud-based inventory and order management platform for product-based businesses – retailers, wholesalers, and light manufacturers – that connects sales channels, warehouses, and accounting. It centralizes stock control, purchasing, production, and fulfillment in one system with built-in POS and warehouse management, plus direct integrations with ecommerce platforms and marketplaces (e.g., Shopify, Amazon) and accounting tools (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks).

​ Location

​ Scarpetta

​ 88 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10016, USA

## Fiber: The Missing Superfood

Fiber is the only nutrient that does something no other can: it feeds your gut microbiome, the trillions of bacteria that control everything from digestion to immunity to mood.

Yet, 95% of Americans don't get enough. The average person consumes only ~15 grams of fiber per day, while recommendations are 25–38 grams.

Typical fiber intake

 Resistant Starch 

 A unique type of fiber that "resists" digestion in your small intestine and travels to your colon, where it feeds beneficial gut bacteria and produces butyrate. 

 Soluble Fiber 

 This type of fiber dissolves in water to form a gel-like substance that slows digestion, helps you feel fuller longer, and binds to cholesterol and sugar to support heart health and blood sugar balance. 

 Insoluble Fiber 

 This fiber does not dissolve in water; instead, it adds bulk to stool and helps food move through your digestive system, supporting a healthy gut environment.

FAQ – Curlfriend Collective 

# FAQ

### Collapsible tabs

Are Customs Fees and Tariffs included?

At this time we do not include any customs fees or tariffs for destination country during checkout. We hope to soon be able to offer this for our Canadian customers.

**Please note that duties and taxes are not included at checkout. Purchaser will be responsible for all duties and taxes for their destination country upon arrival. Please visit our FAQ for more information.

For Canadian Customers:

We would like to provide you with some information on how to decrease your fees upon arrival! Follow the steps below to ensure a seamless and cost effective delivery process. (More details)

1. Contact help@curlfriendcollective.com and ask us to send you a copy of your customs declaration.
2. Take your customs declaration to your nearest CBSA office (find them here) and pay your taxes. Make sure to keep your copy of your customs receipt.
3. Email customs receipt to UPS (canadabrokeragecs@ups.com) . Confirm with them you have paid your duties. They will be able to drop off your package with no brokerage fees attached.

What does Pre-order mean? When will my order ship?

Please read our shipping policy here.

*** Please note that if your order contains at least one items labeled as pre-order, you ENTIRE order will ship out all at once (once all items in your order are in stock).

US Shipping: between $4.99-$20.99 depending on the weight of your order and type of shipping selected during checkout. Curlfriend Collective may offer free shipping during seasonal promotions please see checkout for more details.

International Shipping: Calculated at checkout. Cost will vary depending on order weight, destination country, and chosen shipping type. Curlfriend Collective may offer free shipping during seasonal promotions please see checkout for more details.

***NOTE***: Customs fees are NOT included in the order total. Customs fees are to be paid by the customer upon delivery to the destination country.

Click here for more details.

How do I wash my silk hair accessories?

Care Instructions: When you feel your silk accessories needs a bath, hand wash them separately, in cold water, in a large bowl, and then hang or lay flat on a towel to dry. Ensure that you wash them individually to prevent any staining and bleeding of colors.

If you’d like a gentle, made for silk detergent, we recommend this silk wash here. A gentle detergent is highly recommended to prevent bleeding of the dyed silk, we do not recommend use of regular laundry detergents or soaps.

What are Curlfriend Collective hair accessories made out of?

100% Mulberry Silk, 6A 16 & 22 Momme silk

Why use silk satin instead of polyester satin?

Silk satin is the only satin made from a natural material that's biodegradable, anti-microbial, naturally temperature regulating, while also helping with hair breakage and retaining moisture.

Other satins, like polyester, are the bad for our environment (polyester is petroleum based), don't breath, feel "plastic like", are not anti-microbial, nor are they moisture wicking.

Can I return my items?

Please read our return policy here.

Do you offer shipping protection?

There’s no need to wait weeks for claims to be processed by couriers - protect your parcel with a small fee based on your order value and we’ll offer you a replacement.

### WHAT WE DEEM AS LOST:

- Shipment states ‘delivered’ but you have not received it. Depending on where you live, we ask that you allow up to 7 business days for your parcel to be delivered. Sometimes the courier prematurely marks it as delivered and tries a redelivery, it turns up in a secure location at your property or it may be at your neighbors. 
- Your tracking has not updated for 2 weeks from the ship date.

We reserve the right to class this as a ‘delay’ if there is a high volume of parcels in the network and we are aware of delays, otherwise we will offer a refund or replacement.

### WHAT WE DEEM AS DAMAG

# FAQ

PRODUCTS & AVAILABILITY

B S I D E S New York, NY Tel. 1.347.875.0145 info@bsidesjeans.com 

B Sides Jeans are available online and with select stockists. Please enquire with the studio for particulars, info@bsidesjeans.com

Are SALE purchases eligible for return?

All SALE purchases are FINAL SALE and not eligible for return or exchange. No price adjustments on past purchases.

 Are VINTAGE Lasso Jeans elegible for return?

All reworked vintage items including Vintage Lasso Jeans are FINAL SALE, elegible for exchange or store credit only.

How do B SIDES jeans fit?

True to size. You may size-up for a more relaxed fit.

And B SIDES Vintage?

Our B SIDES Vintage Jeans are re-worked from original Levi’s. Select your modern denim size for truest fit, and size up for a more relaxed fit that sits lower on your hips, with a slouchier leg. Connect with us for more details, at info@bsidesjeans.com

ORDERING & PAYMENT

If I have a question about my order, who will I contact?

You may place an order directly on the website. Alternatively, you may place a phone order by calling the B SIDES studio. We’re available to assist you Monday through Friday from 10am to 6pm, EST by phone 1.347.875.0145 or by email orders@bsidesjeans.com

How does the pre-order process work?

Select items are available for pre-order and are marked accordingly with the item’s expected ship date. Pre-orders require 100% pre-payment at the time of purchase. When the item is shipped, you will receive an email with tracking information for the shipment. Any other items in your order will ship separately.

Can I modify or cancel my order ?

To modify or cancel an order, please contact us within 2 hours of placing your order. You may reach us by dialing 1.347.875.0145 Monday through Friday from 10am to 6pm, EST or sending an e-mail to info@bsidesjeans.com 

SHIPPING

How soon can I expect my order?

Orders are processed the following business day, excluding holidays. Please contact us if RUSH Delivery is required in the NYC-area, and we will do our best to accommodate. 

How do I make a return?

Start a Return HERE

Follow the RETURNS link in the footer, and can also be found via this link: https://bsidesjeans.myshopify.com/apps/returns

If you have any issues, please contact the studio, halle@bsidesjeans.com

How long does it take to process a return?

Once we receive your package, please allow up to 5 business days for your return to be processed. Your refund will be credited back to the same card used to make your original purchase, and you will be notified via email once your return package is received and then again once your refund is completed.

Do you offer free pre-paid return shipping?

A $20 fee applies to cover the return label and re-stock fee for domestic returns, however exchanges and store credit are complimentary. Duties and taxes cannot be refunded on International Order returns.

GIFT CARD POLICY

How do I purchase a Gift Card? 

To purchase a B Sides E-Gift Card, select the amount you'd like and fill out the information below. E-Gift Cards will be sent to the recipient by email within 24 hours. E-Gift Cards are issued in USD $ and never expire.

 For further information and special requests, please email Customer Service.

E-GIFT CARD FAQ

An E-Gift Card purchased on our website is the USD (United States Dollar) monetary equivalent of virtual funds that can only be used toward a purchase made on www.bsidesjeans.com

How do I purchase an E-Gift Card?

1. First select the amount you want to purchase (in USD).
2. Click “add to cart” and proceed to purchase.
3. You will then receive an email with the gift card, which you can then forward to your recipient. Currently, E-Gift Cards are only available to be sent via email. 

How soon will it be processed?

Pending verification and acceptance of your order, E-Gift Cards will be sent to the purchaser via email within one business day.

Will my Gift Card expire?

E-gift cards do not

## About

In 2021, Yousuf left Goldman Sachs Wealth Management to turn his career — and the consumer food system — on its head. He founded Mixtape FoodCo as a response to the staggering waste in our food system and the impact that has on greenhouse gas emissions and food insecurity around the world. Mixtape is a sustainable food company that makes baked goods and snacks powered by upcycled ingredients, currently available at Joe Coffee NY and Dashmart by Doordash. Through upcycling — which redirects nutritious, functional food that would have gone to waste back into the consumer food system — Mixtape is on track to achieve the following this year alone: + Save 305,000 gallons of water + Avoid over 7 tons of CO2 emissions + Rescue over 2 tons of nutrition Our goal is to bring people along the journey and with an irreverent brand, nostalgic spin, and market-tested product line, we’re well positioned to introduce upcycling to a mass market without the historical trade-offs. Our products are vegan, climate-friendly, high-quality, and delicious. Prior to founding Mixtape, Yousuf ran financial operations for businesses and advised successful entrepreneurs on investment strategies for over 12 years. He’s been cooking cuisines across his Middle Eastern, Indian, German and US Southern roots for over 20 years. He also spent four years as an Associate Board Member at Hot Bread Kitchen, an NYC non-profit that creates economic opportunity in the food industry for women, immigrants, and people of color through training, job placement, and entrepreneurship.

About – B Sides Jeans

# About

The B side of a record is where the deep cuts live, the tracks true collectors return to, the ones that reveal themselves slowly.

Founded in 2016 by vintage collectors Claire Lampert and Stacy Daily, B SIDES was built in that same spirit. Rooted in denim and in the singular character of USA vintage Levi’s gathered across the American West, the brand began as an archive of rare jeans and has since evolved into a full ready-to-wear collection.

Today, alongside its reworked and original denim, B SIDES produces wardrobe pieces in small batches from natural fibers such as cotton, wool, cashmere, and silk, made by artisans who have spent generations refining their techniques.

Each piece is designed on instinct rather than formula, with patterns cut from scratch and silhouettes shaped by hand, resulting in modern heirlooms meant to be lived in, loved, and collected over time. B S I D E S New York

# First in Bamboo: Over 20 Years of Innovation 

Based in California, Totally Bamboo continues to lead with eco-friendly innovations in cutting boards, cooking utensils, bowls and more!

## Totally Bamboo Benefits 

- ### Free Shipping on Orders Over $75 
- ### 1-Year Warranty 
- ### Designed in USA 
- ### Women-Owned Company 

## The story of Totally Bamboo began in the land of stories… well, just north of it.

Tom and Joanne Sullivan owned Hollywood Chairs in North Hollywood, supplying director’s chairs to top movie and television productions. In a quest to improve upon their famously comfortable foldable chairs, the Sullivans began experimenting with other material options. They wanted something lighter than their existing oak chairs yet strong enough to last through the production of a blockbuster picture (and its inevitable sequels).

After exhaustive research, they found one material fit the bill better than any other— bamboo!

Bamboo has a higher tensile strength than steel yet is light enough for anyone to easily carry. Not only is bamboo a better material option, but it’s better for the planet too. Despite its tough exterior, bamboo is actually a grass. When harvested the roots remain and quickly regenerate. It’s a truly remarkable and renewable resource.

## Finding an innovative new use for bamboo.

Our first bamboo cutting boards came from scraps from our director's chairs. Initally they were made as Christmas gifts for friends and family. On a lark, we brought them to an art show we were exhibiting in. We were stunned when they sold out in minutes. Joanne looked at Tom and said "this is our new product" and Totally Bamboo was born!

Totally Bamboo has continued to innovate since those first the bamboo cutting boards. Starting with our Hawaiian Collection Cutting Boards, Totally Bamboo also since created:

- The First Laminated Bamboo Salad Bowl
- The First Bamboo Boards with a Decorative Inlay
- GreenLite™: The First Dishwasher-Safe Bamboo Cutting Boards

These innovations and more have led to Totally Bamboo’s current lineup of masterfully crafted cutting boards, beautifully designed bowls, clever utensils and smart storage solutions. 

In addition to bamboo, Totally Bamboo has also branched out into other natural materials in our Rock & Branch®, Baltique® and TB Home® product lines.

Totally Bamboo products are designed in their California headquarters and shipped and serviced from their distribution center in Texas. 

Totally Bamboo is a certified Woman-owned business.

# Agent Instructions — Onnit

You can browse products and shop at Onnit's online store, https://www.onnit.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the Shop skill to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the Universal Commerce Protocol for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. Discover the store — `GET https://www.onnit.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. Discover available tools — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.onnit.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. Shop — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see Shopify's agent documentation.

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- Storefront — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- Checkout — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see Storefront WebMCP and Checkout WebMCP.

## Interaction guidelines

- Buyer authorization — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- Agent traffic — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use Web Bot Auth and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- Browser interactions — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- Rate limits — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- Buyer context — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance

## Buy now, pay later with Shop Pay

Now, when you choose Shop Pay at checkout, you can split your purchase into 4 equal, 0% interest installment payments—with no additional, hidden, or late fees.*

What’s more—when you check out with Shop Pay, the delivery emissions from your order are automatically offset for free.

#### How it works:

1. Add items to your cart. 2. Check out with Shop Pay. 3. Choose to pay in 4 installments

Your first payment will either be due at checkout or 2 weeks after your purchase. The next 3 remaining installments will be automatically charged to your card saved on Shop Pay every 2 weeks. And don't worry, you'll get an email reminder before each payment to keep you in the know.

What is the option to pay in installments on Shop Pay?

When checking out with Shop Pay, you now have the option to pay now or later. Paying in installments on Shop Pay allows you to split your purchase amount into 4 equal, biweekly installment payments—with 0% interest, no hidden or late fees, and no impact on your credit score.

* In some instances, your first payment is due when you make your purchase; otherwise, your first payment is due 2 weeks after your purchase.

 Which payment methods are accepted if I use the option to pay in installments on Shop Pay? 

The installments option on Shop Pay is available on debit and credit cards.

Are there late fees?

No, there are no late fees if you miss a scheduled payment.

What if I make a return on a purchase made through installments with Shop Pay?

If we process a refund, the refunded amount will be returned to your original payment method within 3-10 business days, and your balance will be updated. If your refund is less than your total purchase balance, it might not lower your next payment. Instead, you can expect fewer payments, a smaller final payment, or both. If your refund is more than your purchase balance, the difference will be returned to your original payment method within 3-10 business days.

# Inventory Accountant

About Naked Nutrition

Founded in 2014, Naked Nutrition is a direct-to-consumer supplement brand built around radical transparency - minimal ingredients, no artificial additives, and nothing to hide. With over 1 million customers, 50K+ five-star reviews, and distribution across Shopify Plus, Amazon, and Walmart, we're a proven brand with significant room to grow. This is a rare opportunity to join a lean, founder-led team and have genuine ownership over a high-impact channel.

The Role

The Inventory Accountant is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of inventory, purchasing, and supply chain-related financial transactions for Naked Nutrition. This role serves as the primary link between Accounting, Operations, and third-party logistics providers (3PLs), ensuring inventory movements, receipts, invoices, and costs are properly recorded and reconciled in NetSuite.

 The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with operational awareness and has experience managing inventory reconciliations, investigating discrepancies, and supporting month-end close activities within a fast-paced consumer packaged goods (CPG) environment. 

What You'll Own

Program strategy & growth Build and scale our affiliate program - platform selection, structure, commission tiers, and performance targets across the US, Canada, UK, and EU.

Creator & influencer recruitment Identify, pitch, and onboard fitness, wellness, and lifestyle creators - from nano-influencers to major partners - across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and podcasts.

Partner relationship management Act as the primary contact for all affiliate and creator partners. Drive activation, content output, and long-term retention through proactive relationship building.

Content & campaign coordination Brief partners on product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand messaging. Ensure content aligns with the Naked Nutrition voice and clean-label positioning.

Performance analytics & reporting Own the data: track clicks, conversions, CAC, and attributed revenue by partner and channel. Present clear ROI reporting and optimization recommendations monthly.

International market expansion Develop region-specific strategies for Canada, the UK, and EU - including local platform differences, creator markets, and compliance considerations (FTC, ASA).

Key Responsibilities

- Reconcile inventory balances across ERP system (NetSuite) and 3PL partners.
- Investigate and resolve inventory, receiving, and cost discrepancies.
- Support Accounts Payable with inventory-related invoice reviews.
- Review purchase orders, receipts, and invoices to ensure accurate three-way matching.
- Ensure transactions and invoices are properly coded to the appropriate business unit and general ledger accounts.
- Prepare inventory and balance sheet reconciliations and support month-end close activities.
- Review and process inventory adjustments, write-offs, transfers, and cycle count variances.
- Support inventory valuation, landed cost allocations, and cost of goods sold reporting.
- Partner with Operations, Procurement, and warehouse teams to improve inventory accuracy and strengthen internal controls.
- Assist with audit requests and maintain supporting documentation for inventory-related transactions.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
- 3+ years of NetSuite accounting experience with inventory-related responsibilities.
- Strong understanding of inventory accounting principles and account reconciliations.
- Experience in CPG, food & beverage, supplements, manufacturing, or distribution industries.
- Experience managing inventory across multiple warehouses or 3PL providers.
- Familiarity with cost accounting concepts and inventory valuation methodologies.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Shipping Information

# Shipping Information

## HOW LONG IS STANDARD AND EXPEDITED SHIPPING?

Standard: Expect to receive your order in 1-3 business days. 

Expedited: Your order typically arrives in 1-2 business days.

Business days refer to Monday - Friday and therefore does not include Saturday or Sunday as well as holidays.

## WHERE IS MY ORDER?

Once you place your order you will receive an “Order Confirmation” email from us. This email will contain all order details, including order number, shipping address, billing address, and an itemized list of all products ordered.

## WHAT ARE YOUR SHIPPING FEES?

Lower 48 US States: Free for orders $99+, $9 for orders under $99 

Alaska and Hawaii: Free for orders $129+, $19 for orders under $129

Europe: Shipping calculated at checkout

## DO YOU SHIP TO MY COUNTRY?

We currently ship all products within the U.S. and select products in the UK and Canada. To see which products are available outside the US make sure you are shopping from the correct version of our site which can be selected at the top right next to the cart icon.

## WHERE DO I ENTER MY FIRST-TIME CUSTOMER DISCOUNT CODE?

If you receive a discount code as a first time customer, you will need to enter it on the page where you choose a shipping method. The shipping page is visible after you click "Checkout" while viewing your shopping cart.

On the upper right-hand side of the page, you will see the form below that says “Gift card or discount code” and the button that says “Apply.”

Just enter your discount code in the box and click the “Apply” button. If you do not click the "Apply" button you will not receive your discount.

## CAN I CHANGE MY ORDER OR SHIPMENT ADDRESS?

Our Fulfillment team sends inbound orders to the appropriate warehouse quickly, to get your order shipped to you fast.

You can edit/update/remove items before completing your order. After this point, changes may not be not possible as the order information has already been sent to the warehouse. To see if it is possible to update your order please contact us at sales@nakednutrition.com as soon as possible.

If the wrong shipping address is entered you will be responsible for contacting the resident of the address to try and receive your order.

If you entered an address that does not exist, the order will make its way back to our fulfillment center. Upon receiving, our Fulfillment Team can then redirect your order to your correct address.

Naked Nutrition is not liable for any losses incurred if the customer has provided any incorrect details for their order. Naked Nutrition also reserves the right not to issue a refund for product costs on orders never received, as a result of the incorrect details provided.

## MY CREDIT CARD WAS CHARGED MORE THAN ONCE FOR MY ORDER

If you tried to place an order and had an issue/received an error message such as the wrong CVV code or wrong billing address and then placed a separate order, your credit card summary may show multiple authorizations.

These multiple "authorizations" are not actual charges and will be refunded back to your account shortly.

## ACCORDING TO THE TRACKING LINK MY ORDER WAS DELIVERED BUT I HAVE NOT RECEIVED ANYTHING

Before contacting us we recommend looking all over your property as the shipping carrier may have left your package in a safe location away from the view of the public.

I f you live in an apartment complex, your package may have been delivered to a parcel locker (you should have been given a key by the USPS to access the locker) or to the Leasing or complex Manager's Office.

Also note that especially during holiday times, shippers may show a package as delivered a few hours or day before it actually arrives.

### Job Description

 Senior Accountant 

 Location: New York, NY Reports to: Accounting Manager 

 About Petite Plume 

 Petite Plume is a high-growth luxury lifestyle brand rooted in timeless design, premium craftsmanship, and an unwavering dedication to comfort. We are a direct-to-consumer–led business, with a rapidly scaling DTC channel at the center of our growth and brand-building strategy. 

 Alongside our strong online presence, we maintain a selective footprint in major retail doors including Neiman Marcus, Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Maisonette, and Shopbop. As we continue to accelerate, we remain grounded in exceptional quality, thoughtful detail, and long-term brand vision. 

 We are building a team that is energized by growth, motivated by excellence, and excited to help shape what comes next. 

 About the Role 

 Petite Plume is seeking a hands-on Senior Accountant to serve as a key partner and primary backup to the Accounting Manager. In a lean, growing finance and accounting organization, this role will independently own significant areas of the monthly and annual close, support accurate and timely financial reporting, strengthen controls and process documentation, and help scale accounting operations across Petite Plume's e-commerce and wholesale channels. 

 The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is process-oriented, proactive, and comfortable investigating and resolving nonroutine issues, combining strong accounting judgment with a continuous-improvement mindset while preserving accuracy, confidentiality, auditability, and timely reporting. 

### Key Responsibilities 

 Close and Financial Reporting 

- Independently own assigned areas of the monthly and annual close, from source data through journal entries, reconciliations, and review-ready supporting schedules. 
- Perform balance sheet reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and aging items, resolving root causes on a timely basis. 
- Prepare account-level variance analyses and preliminary results, proactively flagging unusual trends, errors, risks, and process-improvement opportunities. 
- Maintain assigned close checklists and deadlines, escalating issues early when they could affect reporting accuracy or timing. 
- Serve as primary backup to the Accounting Manager, developing the capability to execute core close responsibilities during absences. 

 Retail and E-Commerce Accounting 

- Reconcile revenue, cash receipts, and merchant settlements across e-commerce, wholesale, and payment platforms, accounting for returns, refunds, discounts, chargebacks, fees, and revenue cutoff. 
- Support inventory and COGS accounting, including reconciliations, reserves, landed costs, freight, duties and tariffs, physical counts, and period-end cutoff. 
- Support cash, prepaid expenses, accruals, fixed assets, payroll, corporate card, and T&E accounting as assigned. 

 Controls, Processes, and Systems 

- Identify control gaps and process inefficiencies; help implement scalable solutions — including automation — that improve accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across T&E, AP, AR, and cash-application workflows. 
- Support accounting-system implementations, integrations, master-data maintenance, and data-validation efforts as needed. 

 Audit, Compliance, and Team Support 

- Own assigned audit schedules and documentation, responding to external auditor requests accurately and promptly. 
- Support tax, regulatory, and other compliance activities in coordination with internal and external partners. 
- Perform ad hoc accounting analyses and support special projects as needed.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field. 
- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful ownership of month-end close and general l

# Finance Manager for an E-commerce DTC Company (UK-Based/Remote)

#### Paired Latin America 1 year ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Paired has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

COMPANY

Our client is a D2C brand specializing in premium accessory organizers, with a growing presence in the USA, Canada, Europe, and Asia. The brand encourages individuality, uniqueness, and personal growth through its products, embodying the message to always "be distinct" and stand out from the crowd.

The business has scaled to $7m in annual revenue in 4 years and has ambitious plans to 4X that growth over the next five years.

ROLE

The Finance Manager oversees the company's accounting and financial operations, ensuring accurate bookkeeping in QuickBooks, conducting weekly bank reconciliations, and managing accounts payable. Key responsibilities include issuing retailer invoices, invoicing collective shipping costs from Shopify, and completing monthly accounting closures. The role requires full bank reconciliations, marketplace revenue recognition, accounts receivable, and payroll reconciliations, as well as calculating the cost of goods sold (COGS). Weekly updates on accounts payable and cash flow forecasts are also necessary.

Additionally, the Finance Manager analyzes omni-channel margins, calculates monthly margins, and conducts profit & loss (P&L) and balance sheet analyses, presenting findings to stakeholders. Tax management includes handling VAT for the UK and DE, summarizing VAT quarterly, and coordinating tax filings with US and UK CPAs. This role also manages intellectual property, oversees patents, coordinates with legal teams, and processes copyright applications.

The Finance Manager further supports the customer service team with payment orders and assists shareholders regarding vendor and contractor contracts.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Bookkeeping - Quickbooks

- Weekly AP entries
- Retailers invoicing on request
- Weekly Shopify collective shipping invoices
- Monthly accounting close including full reconciliation of banks, AR, debts, credit cards, payroll, and COGS calculation.
- Cash flow management

- Track credit card balances and liaise with lenders.
- Margin/Financials management

- Financial reporting to stakeholders and analysis of new products.
- Tax responsibilities
- - Weekly VAT filings and quarterly reports
- Coordinate with US and UK CPAs for tax filings.
- Other support
- - Assist customer service with payment orders
- Support shareholders with vendor/contractor contracts.

Requirements

- Familiarity (ideally first hand experience) with Amazon marketplace and Shopify reporting systems

- Good understanding of cash vs accrual based accounting

- Must have experience with ecommerce and inventory-holding businesses for COGS calculation

- Must be a Certified Bookkeeper

- CPA certification or access to a CPA for financial reviews is preferred
- Good communication skills
- Experience with QBO is required

Benefits

- Competitive salary.
- Ability to work remotely.

# Petite Plume

Petite Plume is a Retail Apparel and Fashion company. Petite Plume is a luxury pajamas and designer sleepwear company that offers soft and high-quality cotton. They provide a wide range of sleepwear for adults and kids. Petite Plume employs 75 people (+50.0% YoY, +25 people), founded in 2015. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Italy.

## About

Petite Plume was inspired by the desire to create sophisticated and comfortable sleepwear in the most exquisite cotton available. In this elegant range of sleepwear, you will see elements of classic colors and styles reminiscent of a bygone era.

The finest attention to detail can be seen throughout the range, from engraved buttons and tuck pointing to handwritten gift cards and customized packaging, making them the ideal gift. Add a monogram to make it even more memorable.

Adult sleepwear:
Our adult collection is made from 100% of the finest cotton. The fabric is preshrunk and yarn-dyed to prevent fade. The superior fabric is then brushed for added softness and gets cozier with each wash.

Children's sleepwear:
We are proud that our children's sleepwear is made with the finest quality cotton and blended with just enough inherently flame retardant fiber to allow our sleepwear to pass strict CPSC regulations without the use of harmful chemicals. The fabric is preshrunk and yarn-dyed to prevent fade. The superior fabric is then brushed for added softness and gets cozier with each wash.

Bonne nuit, ma petite plume.

# Financial Controller - E-commerce Brand - Remote/Worldwide

## Paired provided pay range 

 This range is provided by Paired. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more. 

### Base pay range

 $9,000.00/yr - $12,000.00/yr 

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

About Us

We are a growing luxury beauty brand operating in the direct-to-consumer (DTC) space. As we scale, we need a detail-oriented financial professional who can bring structure, accuracy, and strategic insight to our financial operations. This role is essential to ensuring our business runs smoothly behind the scenes while we focus on delivering exceptional products to our customers. 

The Role

Accountant / Controller - E-commerce Brand

We're seeking an experienced Controller to manage our day-to-day financial operations and provide the financial foundation that supports our growth. This is a strategic finance role requiring e-commerce + retail experience in the US market—not basic bookkeeping.

This is not just a bookkeeping role—we need someone who can think strategically about our finances, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure we maintain healthy cash flow and financial practices as we expand.

Financial Operations

- Manage full-cycle AP/AR and own the finance inbox
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors (Shopify, PayPal, Stripe)
- Process invoices, payments, and vendor relationships
- Maintain accurate financial records with end-to-end bookkeeping accuracy

Strategic Finance

- Develop monthly/annual budgets and forecast cash flow
- Monitor spending vs. budget and flag variances
- Track COGS, marketing spend, and operational expenses
- Understand inventory accounting, revenue recognition, and multi-channel sales (DTC + retail/wholesale)

Reporting & Analysis

- Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheets, and cash flow statements
- Track key e-commerce metrics (CAC, AOV, margins)
- Provide actionable insights to leadership
- Support year-end tax prep and maintain audit-ready documentation

Collaboration

- Work closely with external CFO and accounting partners
- Coordinate with tax professionals as needed
- Ensure compliance with tax obligations and filing deadlines 

Requirements 

Required Qualifications

- Proven Controller or senior accounting experience in e-commerce + retail
- US market experience required
- Strong understanding of e-commerce financials: payment processors, shipping costs, inventory, sales tax
- QuickBooks Online (QBO) proficiency - mandatory
- Advanced Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling
- Experience with Shopify and multi-channel sales operations
- Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent English communication skills

Preferred

- Bill.com experience
- Accounting certification (CPA, CMA)
- Beauty/skincare/luxury brand experience
- Multi-currency and international payments knowledge
- Sales tax compliance expertise (Nexus, filing)

Success Metrics

- Accurate, current financial records at all times
- Timely invoice and payment processing
- Clear monthly financial reporting for decision-making
- Proactive cash flow management
- Scalable, efficient financial processes 

Benefits 

- Remote Working for US Company
- Exposure to new technology & trend
- Competitive Salary

# Finance and Accounting Specialist (SaaS/US Clients) | June 2026 Start

- On-site
- - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
- ₹1,800,000 - ₹2,400,000 per year
- Customer Success

## Job description

## About the Role

You're the person merchants call when their numbers don't add up. When a Shopify payout doesn't reconcile with the P&L, when COGS looks off, when a multi-currency gap shows up, you dig in, find the root cause, and walk the merchant through it. These are high-growth eCommerce brands selling across Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop. They use Fulfil as their ERP, and you're their first point of contact when something doesn't tie out.

You'll work with merchants ranging from D2C founders doing their own books to finance teams at 9-figure brands, both of whom need you to be sharp, clear, and confident on the call. Internally, you'll partner with our Engineering, Implementation, and Success teams in Bangalore.

If you thrive on variety, own problems end-to-end, and can explain a multi-currency FX discrepancy to a non-accountant in under two minutes, keep reading.

## About Fulfil

Fulfil is an ERP built for high-growth eCommerce brands. Our merchants run complex, multi-channel operations across Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and beyond relying on Fulfil to keep their financials accurate, reconciled, and audit-ready.

## What You'll Actually Do

Day-to-day, you will:

- Own merchant accounting issues end-to-end: troubleshoot reconciliation discrepancies between Fulfil and sales channels like Shopify and Amazon, and walk merchants through exactly what went wrong and why
- Guide merchants on eCommerce accounting fundamentals: support merchants with COGS tracking, inventory valuation, revenue recognition, and multi-channel transaction reconciliation within Fulfil
- Implementation support: partner with the Implementation team on new merchant onboarding and advising on accounting workflow design, chart of accounts setup, and core financial configuration to ensure merchants go live on solid footing 
- Communicate clearly to diverse audiences: explain financial concepts to both technically savvy controllers and accountant-averse founders
- Support merchants through audits: help them pull the right documentation and reconciliations from Fulfil
- Advise on compliance and currency exposure: help merchants navigate sales tax across geographies (multiple US states, Canadian provinces, UK and others) and multi-currency accounting considerations
- Lead product adoption: identify where merchants are underutilizing Fulfil’s financial features, run targeted training session and consult on process improvements to drive longer-term value 
- Collaborate cross-functionally: surface recurring merchant pain points to Implementation, Support, and Engineering teams to shape product enhancements
- Leverage AI to move faster: use tools like Claude to clarify accounting treatments, compress context, or draft merchant updates

A realistic day might look like:

- Helping come up with a cutover plan for a merchant migrating from their current accounting software to Fulfil
- Helping a user troubleshoot and reconcile discrepancies within their ledger balances
- Conducting a training session with users, consulting and providing best practices
- Working closely with our product team by iterating on customer feedback

## Job requirements

## What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of accounting, audit, or finance-SaaS implementation/support experience — at an eCommerce company, a multi-client accounting BPO with eCommerce clients, a US/UK-focused accounting BPO, or as a functional/implementation consultant on a finance ERP 
- Hands-on working experience reconciling and closing books, not just familiarity
- Strong understanding of US GAAP and eCommerce-specific accounting: revenue recognition across channels, COGS, inventory valuation, and settlement reconciliation

Search Kickoff Worksheet: A Completed Example — Paired Sourcing

# What a Completed Search Kickoff Worksheet Looks Like

 Nov 5 

Written by Paired Sourcing

Jer Langhans Founder, Paired Sourcing

A kickoff meeting can feel productive without giving anyone a clear direction for the search. The hiring manager wants someone strategic, hands-on, and comfortable with ambiguity. The recruiter takes good notes. Everyone leaves feeling aligned, until the first profiles arrive and it becomes clear that they were picturing different people.

The useful work happens when those broad descriptions turn into decisions. What does this person need to accomplish? Which capabilities have to be there on day one? Where might someone have done comparable work, even if their title or industry looks different?

Our Search Kickoff Worksheet puts those questions in one place. Here is what filling it out could look like, and how the answers would shape the research.

Illustrative example: The company, search, dates, and completed notes below are hypothetical.

## The search we are using

Imagine a B2B software company hiring a senior product marketing manager. The founder still carries too much of the sales story. Different salespeople explain the product differently, and marketing needs a clearer way to connect its capabilities to the problems buyers are trying to solve.

The job description starts with “strategic product marketer with SaaS experience.” That gives us a category. The worksheet needs to give us a direction.

> Role / team: Senior Product Marketing Manager / Marketing

> Hiring manager / recruiting contact / date: Head of Marketing / Internal recruiter / November 6, 2026

## 1. What must this person accomplish in their first 6 to 12 months?

> Example entry: Develop a clear positioning story grounded in customer and sales conversations. Use it to guide launch messaging and create sales materials that explain the business value without relying on the founder to translate.

Now we have something to research. We are looking for evidence that someone has understood buyers, made choices about positioning, and helped sales explain a product. A list of launches might be relevant, but it does not answer those questions by itself.

## 2. Which requirements are truly nonnegotiable?

> Example entry: Must have taken customer or prospect insights into a positioning or messaging decision, explained a complex product to business buyers, and worked directly with sales. Experience in our exact software category is a preference. Knowledge of our product can be learned.

This is where I would push on “SaaS experience.” Does the person need to understand a subscription business, a particular buyer, or a complex sales process? Those are different requirements. Naming the underlying capability gives the recruiter something more useful than a keyword to enforce.

## 3. What does an ideal candidate look like in the real world?

> Example entry: A product marketer who helped clarify the sales story for a complex B2B product. We would also consider someone from solutions consulting or sales enablement if they owned customer research and positioning decisions, beyond presenting materials someone else created.

The second background belongs in the research because the work might be comparable. It is still a hypothesis. A public profile may suggest relevant experience, while leaving ownership and depth unclear. Those become questions for the hiring team to assess, rather than assumptions we quietly treat as facts.

## 4. Where can we be flexible?

> Example entry: Open to adjacent B2B software categories and different current titles. Remote within the United States is workable. The approved compensation range still needs confirmation before outreach; record it as an open decision rather than guessing.
